nodes.title: 🛑 ⚠️ these will error if both are turned off
💡Hints:

en.text:
**Sizing:**
- Turn **max resolution** down if you are low on **VRAM.**
- 🗑️ in, 🗑️ out. Use good-quality images.
- Use **LC Get Image 📐** when you need aspect ratio and megapixels.
- ⚠️ Watch the original size. If the image is small and **use image aspect ratio** is on, it will process at that size.

**Proportion**
- Use **resize** when combining several images. Use **crop** when you want 🥅 ControlNet.

**I2I works *but*…** it will mess with Image Reference. Use it sparingly.
- 💡 I never touch it unless I want the basic composition of the image without the rigidity that Image Reference or ControlNet gives me.

zh.text:
**尺寸设置：**
- 如果显存（VRAM）不足，请降低 **最大分辨率**。
- 🗑️ 输入，🗑️ 输出。请使用高质量图片。
- 需要保持宽高比和像素数时，请使用 **LC 获取图像 📐**。
- ⚠️ 注意原始尺寸。如果图片本身较小且 **使用图像宽高比** 开启，则会按该尺寸进行处理。

**比例控制**
- 合并多张图片时使用 **缩放**；若希望使用 🥅 ControlNet，请使用 **裁剪**。

**I2I 可以工作 *但*…** 它会影响图像参考（Image Reference）。请谨慎使用。
- 💡 除非我想要在不依赖图像参考或 ControlNet 刚性结构的情况下获得基础构图，否则我从不手动调整它。

ja.text:
**サイズ:**
- **VRAM** が足りないときは **max resolution** を下げます。
- 🗑️ in, 🗑️ out。質の良い画像を使ってください。
- アスペクト比とメガピクセルが必要なときは **LC Get Image 📐** を使います。
- ⚠️ 元のサイズに注意。画像が小さくて **use image aspect ratio** がオンだと、そのサイズのまま処理されます。

**プロポーション**
- 複数の画像を組み合わせるときは **resize** を使います。🥅 ControlNet を使いたいときは **crop** を使います。

**I2I は使えます、*ただし*…** Image Reference を乱します。控えめに使ってください。
- 💡 私が使うのは、Image Reference や ControlNet のような硬さなしに、画像の基本的な構図だけが欲しいときだけです。

ko.text:
**크기:**
- **VRAM**이 부족하면 **max resolution**을 낮추세요.
- 🗑️ in, 🗑️ out. 품질 좋은 이미지를 쓰세요.
- 종횡비와 메가픽셀이 필요하면 **LC Get Image 📐**를 쓰세요.
- ⚠️ 원본 크기를 확인하세요. 이미지가 작은데 **use image aspect ratio**가 켜져 있으면 그 크기로 처리됩니다.

**비율**
- 여러 이미지를 합칠 때는 **resize**를, 🥅 ControlNet이 필요할 때는 **crop**을 쓰세요.

**I2I도 되긴 *하지만*…** Image Reference를 망칩니다. 가끔만 쓰세요.
- 💡 저는 Image Reference나 ControlNet 같은 경직됨 없이 이미지의 기본 구도만 원할 때가 아니면 건드리지 않습니다.

nodes.title: Notes:

en.text:
### 👉The Krea 2 Model does **NOT do I2I like Klein_9b.** It uses the images as reference. It will **NOT** reproduce an image directly.


### Base Prompt Encode 📝

- Use for normal T2I and normal I2I

---
### Image Edit 🖼️🔁
**⚠️🚫 This does not work if **Sage Attention** is on!** It must be off above (in ⚙️ User Settings) as well as in your **start.bat** file

**Instructions**
- Make sure to turn the switch on 
- Image 1 is your original pic
- Turn on image 2 as needed
- Set the prompt in the main prompt area

---

### 🪪 Identity Edit
- **⚠️ Image Edit 🖼️🔁** must be **ON** for this to work
- Can be used for both images
- **ref boost**
   - bottom image should be higher than top. 
   - If you use a face pic in the bottom to transfer to the top, set to 4. Otherwise 1.0 for image 1 and 2.0 for image 2 typically works

---
### 🥅 Controlnet
- Use the base prompt 📝 only
- 🪪 ID Edit must be off


## ⚠️ 🥅 Controlnet can make it look plastic or painted. turn the strength down (or up if it stops holding a pose)
- The break seems to be between 0.6 and 0.8

[Krea 2 controlnet nodes](https://github.com/facok/comfyui-krea2-controlnet)

**Controlnet LoRA**

- [Krea 2 depth controlnet LoRA](https://huggingface.co/Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet/resolve/main/depth-control-lora.safetensors?download=true)
- I am assuming that as this model advances, there will be more as of July 7th, 2026, only Depth is available.


**⚙️ settings**

## ⚠️ **Base prompt encode📝**  needs to be used 

- **AIO Preprocessor**: again, I assume this model will get more options. Right now leave it at **depth**

- **LoRA strength** seems to work best at 1.0

**Krea2 Control Image Encode:**
- I have it set for "Match Image Latent", which automatically resizes it per the workflow size. 
- Crop and other settings are not needed unless you override the latent.

zh.text:
### 👉Krea 2模型**不支持像Klein_9b那样的I2I功能。**它使用图像作为参考。它**不会**直接复制图像。


### 基础提示编码 📝

- 适用于普通T2I和普通I2I

---
### 图像编辑 🖼️🔁
**⚠️🚫 如果启用了“Sage Attention”，此功能将无法工作！** 必须在⚙️用户设置中关闭，同时也要在你的**start.bat**文件中关闭

**操作说明**
- 请确保开启开关
- 图像1是你的原始图片
- 根据需要开启图像2
- 在主提示区域输入提示语

---

### 🪪 身份编辑
- **⚠️ 必须开启“图像编辑 🖼️🔁”功能才能使用此功能**
- 可用于两张图片
- **ref boost**
   - 底图的值应高于顶图。
   - 如果你用一张人脸图作为底图，将其传输到顶图，设置为4。否则，通常图像1设为1.0，图像2设为2.0即可

---
### 🥅 Controlnet
- 只使用基础提示 📝
- 🪪 身份编辑必须关闭


## ⚠️ 🥅 Controlnet 可能会让画面看起来像塑料或像画出来的。把 strength 调低（如果它不再保持姿势，就调高）
- 分界点似乎在 0.6 到 0.8 之间

[Krea 2 controlnet 节点](https://github.com/facok/comfyui-krea2-controlnet)

**Controlnet LoRA**

- [Krea 2 depth controlnet LoRA](https://huggingface.co/Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet/resolve/main/depth-control-lora.safetensors?download=true)
- 我估计随着这个模型的发展会有更多选择，截至 2026年7月7日，只有 Depth 可用。


**⚙️ 设置**

## ⚠️ 需要使用**基础提示编码📝**

- **AIO Preprocessor**：同样，我估计这个模型以后会有更多选项。现在保持 **depth** 即可

- **LoRA strength** 似乎在 1.0 时效果最好

**Krea2 Control Image Encode：**
- 我把它设为 "Match Image Latent"，它会按照工作流的尺寸自动调整大小。
- 除非你覆盖了 latent，否则不需要 Crop 和其他设置。

ja.text:
### 👉Krea 2モデルは**Klein_9bのようなI2Iは行いません。**画像は参照として使われるだけで、画像をそのまま再現することは**ありません**。


### Base Prompt Encode 📝

- 通常のT2Iと通常のI2Iに使います

---
### Image Edit 🖼️🔁
**⚠️🚫 **Sage Attention**がオンだと動きません！** 上の(⚙️ User Settingsの)設定でも、**start.bat**ファイルでもオフにする必要があります

**手順**
- スイッチを必ずオンにします
- Image 1は元の画像です
- 必要に応じてimage 2をオンにします
- プロンプトはメインのプロンプトエリアに入れます

---

### 🪪 Identity Edit
- これを動かすには**⚠️ Image Edit 🖼️🔁**を**ON**にする必要があります
- 両方の画像に使えます
- **ref boost**
   - 下の画像のほうを、上より高くします。
   - 下に顔写真を置いて上に転写するなら、4にします。それ以外は、image 1が1.0、image 2が2.0でたいていうまくいきます

---
### 🥅 Controlnet
- Base prompt 📝だけを使います
- 🪪 ID Editはオフにします


## ⚠️ 🥅 Controlnet を使うと、プラスチックや絵のような見た目になることがあります。strength を下げてください（ポーズが保てなくなったら上げてください）
- 境目は 0.6 から 0.8 の間のようです

[Krea 2 controlnet ノード](https://github.com/facok/comfyui-krea2-controlnet)

**Controlnet LoRA**

- [Krea 2 depth controlnet LoRA](https://huggingface.co/Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet/resolve/main/depth-control-lora.safetensors?download=true)
- このモデルが進化すれば増えていくと思いますが、2026年7月7日時点では Depth だけです。


**⚙️ 設定**

## ⚠️ **Base prompt encode📝** を使う必要があります

- **AIO Preprocessor**: これもモデルが進めば選択肢が増えると思います。今は **depth** のままにしてください

- **LoRA strength** は 1.0 がいちばん良いようです

**Krea2 Control Image Encode:**
- "Match Image Latent" に設定してあるので、ワークフローのサイズに合わせて自動でリサイズされます。
- latent を上書きしない限り、Crop などの設定は必要ありません。

ko.text:
### 👉Krea 2 모델은 Klein_9b처럼 I2I를 **하지 않습니다.** 이미지를 레퍼런스로 사용합니다. 이미지를 그대로 재현하지 **않습니다**.


### Base Prompt Encode 📝

- 일반 T2I와 일반 I2I에 사용

---
### Image Edit 🖼️🔁
**⚠️🚫 **Sage Attention**이 켜져 있으면 작동하지 않습니다!** 위쪽(⚙️ User Settings)과 **start.bat** 파일에서 모두 꺼야 합니다

**사용 방법**
- 스위치를 켜는 것을 잊지 마세요
- Image 1이 원본 사진입니다
- 필요하면 image 2를 켜세요
- 프롬프트는 메인 프롬프트 영역에 쓰세요

---

### 🪪 Identity Edit
- 이게 작동하려면 **⚠️ Image Edit 🖼️🔁**가 **ON**이어야 합니다
- 두 이미지 모두에 쓸 수 있습니다
- **ref boost**
   - 아래쪽 이미지가 위쪽보다 높아야 합니다.
   - 아래쪽의 얼굴 사진을 위쪽으로 옮기는 경우에는 4로 설정하세요. 그 외에는 보통 image 1은 1.0, image 2는 2.0이 잘 맞습니다

---
### 🥅 Controlnet
- Base prompt 📝만 사용하세요
- 🪪 ID Edit는 꺼야 합니다


## ⚠️ 🥅 Controlnet을 쓰면 플라스틱이나 그림처럼 보일 수 있습니다. strength를 낮추세요 (포즈를 유지하지 못하면 높이세요)
- 경계는 0.6에서 0.8 사이인 것 같습니다

[Krea 2 controlnet 노드](https://github.com/facok/comfyui-krea2-controlnet)

**Controlnet LoRA**

- [Krea 2 depth controlnet LoRA](https://huggingface.co/Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet/resolve/main/depth-control-lora.safetensors?download=true)
- 이 모델이 발전하면 더 늘어날 거라고 생각하지만, 2026년 7월 7일 기준으로는 Depth만 있습니다.


**⚙️ 설정**

## ⚠️ **Base prompt encode📝**를 사용해야 합니다

- **AIO Preprocessor**: 이것도 모델이 발전하면 옵션이 늘어날 것 같습니다. 지금은 **depth**로 두세요

- **LoRA strength**는 1.0이 가장 잘 맞는 것 같습니다

**Krea2 Control Image Encode:**
- "Match Image Latent"로 설정해 두어서, 워크플로 크기에 맞게 자동으로 리사이즈됩니다.
- latent를 덮어쓰지 않는 한 Crop 등 다른 설정은 필요 없습니다.

nodes.title: Notes:

en.text:
## LC Vision Caption 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ This auto downloads the model you choose on the first run, so it will take several minutes.
- The model selector shows your already downloaded options as well as available downloads.

**LC Vision Caption 📝**:
- 💡 The node analyzes the image and detects subject, pose, clothing, setting, lighting, color, composition, and mood, not just a one-line summary.
- Each reference gets its own label (`<Reference 1>`, `<Reference 2>`, `<Reference 3>`), described individually instead of mashed into one blob. 😎
- `style_tag` pushes the description toward a specific visual style regardless of what the reference actually looks like.

**💡 Analyzing 3 images at once**
- Custom prompt: "Analyze <Reference 1>, <Reference 2>, and <Reference 3> individually: describe each one's subject, setting, lighting, and mood. Then compare all three and note the key similarities and differences between them."
- The model addresses each picture by its own label instead of blending them together.

zh.text:
## LC Vision Caption 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**：
- ⚠️ 首次运行会自动下载你选择的模型，所以要等几分钟。
- 模型选择器会同时显示你已下载的选项和可下载的选项。

**LC Vision Caption 📝**：
- 💡 这个节点会分析图片，识别主体、姿势、服装、场景、光线、色彩、构图和情绪，而不只是一句话的概括。
- 每张参考图都有自己的标签（`<Reference 1>`、`<Reference 2>`、`<Reference 3>`），分别描述，而不是糊成一团。😎
- `style_tag` 会把描述推向某种特定的视觉风格，不管参考图实际是什么样。

**💡 一次分析 3 张图**
- 自定义提示词："Analyze <Reference 1>, <Reference 2>, and <Reference 3> individually: describe each one's subject, setting, lighting, and mood. Then compare all three and note the key similarities and differences between them."
- 模型会按各自的标签称呼每张图片，而不是把它们混在一起。

ja.text:
## LC Vision Caption 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ 選んだモデルは初回実行時に自動でダウンロードされるので、数分かかります。
- モデルセレクターには、ダウンロード済みのものとダウンロード可能なものが表示されます。

**LC Vision Caption 📝**:
- 💡 このノードは画像を分析して、被写体、ポーズ、服装、場所、ライティング、色、構図、ムードを検出します。一行の要約だけではありません。
- 各リファレンスには個別のラベル（`<Reference 1>`、`<Reference 2>`、`<Reference 3>`）が付き、ひとかたまりにせず1枚ずつ説明されます。😎
- `style_tag` は、リファレンスの実際の見た目に関係なく、説明を特定のビジュアルスタイルに寄せます。

**💡 3枚を同時に分析する**
- Custom prompt: "Analyze <Reference 1>, <Reference 2>, and <Reference 3> individually: describe each one's subject, setting, lighting, and mood. Then compare all three and note the key similarities and differences between them."
- モデルは各画像をそれぞれのラベルで呼び、混ぜ合わせません。

ko.text:
## LC Vision Caption 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ 처음 실행할 때 선택한 모델을 자동으로 다운로드하므로 몇 분 걸립니다.
- 모델 선택기에는 이미 다운로드한 옵션과 다운로드할 수 있는 옵션이 함께 표시됩니다.

**LC Vision Caption 📝**:
- 💡 이 노드는 이미지를 분석해서 피사체, 포즈, 의상, 배경, 조명, 색감, 구도, 분위기를 감지합니다. 한 줄 요약에 그치지 않습니다.
- 각 참조에는 고유한 라벨(`<Reference 1>`, `<Reference 2>`, `<Reference 3>`)이 붙고, 하나로 뭉뚱그리지 않고 개별적으로 묘사됩니다. 😎

nodes.title: LC123 Settings ⚙️

en.text:
# LC123 Settings ⚙️

**Where are they?** Open **Settings** (the gear), then **LC123 Settings ⚙️**. There are five sections: **Align**, **Connections**, **Notes**, **Optimization** and **Performance**.

- 💡 Missing a setting? Restart ComfyUI, then press **Ctrl+F5** so the browser loads the new files.

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- Default: **On**
- The switch for the whole tool. Off = no **Align** button (the LC logo) in the top toolbar and none of the features below.
- With it on, the **Align** button turns Align on or off **for the open workflow**: light gray with the red flame = on, dark gray with a gray flame = off.
    - That on/off is saved in the workflow. Save it with Align on and it opens with Align on, even on a fresh ComfyUI.
    - Every workflow tab keeps its own. Switch tabs and the tool follows that tab (on in one, off in the other, no mix-ups).
    - Turning it on or off counts as a change to the workflow, so you get the unsaved dot.
- Nodes snap to **Node lines**, groups snap to **Group lines**. A line lights up when you get close.
- Works on the classic canvas and in **Nodes 2.0**.
- **Snap distance** is ComfyUI's own **Snap to grid size** (Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas). Smaller grid = tighter snap. New lines land on that grid too.
    - **Shift** while dragging hands the drag to ComfyUI's own grid snap (no line snap). With **Always snap to grid** on, a line snap still wins on the axis it caught.

**Rulers**
- Default: **On**
- Rulers on the top and left edge while Align is on:
    - **Left click** a ruler: adds a **Node line** (blue). Nodes snap to it.
    - **Right click** a ruler: adds a **Group line** (orange). Groups snap to it.
    - Click a line's marker again to remove it. Drag a marker to move it.
- Lines save with the workflow.

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- Default: **120**
- Lines stay invisible until the cursor or whatever you drag gets this close.

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- Default: **Off**
- On = also snap to other nodes' edges and centers (no line is shown for those).

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- Default: **Off**
- While you drag a wire, every socket it can plug into glows in its socket color.
- Get close and rings pulse out of the socket. Closer = bigger and brighter.
- **Connection FX reach (px):** how close the cursor has to be before the rings start. Default 160.
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%):** zoomed out, every valid socket glows brighter so you can find it. Default 60.
- Classic canvas only. With **Nodes 2.0** on it stays out of the way.

---



---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Optimization report**
- One button. It pans the canvas by itself for a few seconds, times what every pack in the open workflow draws and runs, and scans their files.
- You get a list of what slows your canvas down, biggest first, sorted into:
    - **That pack's own settings** (the exact setting name, where it lives and its current value)
    - **LC123 optimization settings**
    - **ComfyUI settings**
    - **Sidebar tabs**
    - **Required to function** (no setting, it is how that pack works)
- Only node packs used in the open workflow are analyzed.
- Every setting it suggests is checked against its current value:
    - ⚠️ big gain · ✅ worthwhile gain · 💡 small gain
    - ⚪ already set · ➖ does not apply · ℹ️ required, no setting for it
- **Show last run:** the button at the top flips to the previous report. Each new run also shows what got faster and which fixes are done since last time.
    - Only the last run is kept (it survives a refresh). Each run replaces it.
- Nothing is changed. (Keep the mouse still while it runs.)
- 💡 Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.

---

### ⚡ Performance

These only change what you see on the canvas. Generation, VRAM, **Save Image** and every **IMAGE** output stay full resolution. (A lighter preview never means a lighter image.)

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | Turns off the hover A/B wipe on LC image FX nodes. The last result still shows. |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | Draws FX previews at half size. Less work while panning. |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | Shrinks on-node previews so the longest side fits **Max edge**. |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | Only used when **Clamp longest side** is on. Range 256 to 2048. Try 512 on heavy graphs. |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | Collapsed FX nodes skip drawing their preview. |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hides every LC image FX preview. |
| **Recent colors** | On | Keeps your last 8 custom colors in the right-click **Colors** menu. Adds a Custom picker if Custom Scripts is not installed. |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | **LC Skin Beauty** keeps a full-quality preview even with half-res or clamp on, so you can still zoom into skin. Wipe still follows **Remove wipe**. |
| **LoRA loader info button** | On | Shows the ℹ button on each **LC LoRA Loader** row. Trigger words come from the LoRA file itself (no internet). Turn off to declutter. |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | Like node text, an on-node image switches off when you zoom out far enough that it is drawn smaller than this. Smaller previews switch off first. 0 = always draw. |

**Never affected:** **LC Image Compare 🔎**, **LC Image Split 🖼️** and **LC Dynamic Overlay** keep their full preview and wipe no matter what (only **Preview distance** switches them off when zoomed far out).

**Suggested setups**
- **Normal use:** leave everything at default.
- **Laggy graph:** turn on **Half-resolution previews** and **Clamp longest side** (Max edge 512). Keep **No preview when collapsed** on.
- **Lightest canvas:** turn on **Hide FX on-node previews**. Use **Image Compare** or **Image Split** when you need to see a before/after.
- 💡 Changes apply on the next redraw. Pan the canvas a little, no restart needed.

---

zh.text:
# LC123 Settings ⚙️

**在哪里？** 打开 **Settings**（齿轮），然后找 **LC123 Settings ⚙️**。共有五个部分：**Align**、**Connections**、**Notes**、**Optimization** 和 **Performance**。

- 💡 找不到某个设置？重启 ComfyUI，然后按 **Ctrl+F5**，让浏览器加载新文件。

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- 默认：**开**
- 整个工具的总开关。关 = 顶部工具栏里没有 **Align** 按钮（LC 标志），下面所有功能也都没有。
- 打开后，**Align** 按钮用来**为当前打开的工作流**开关 Align：浅灰色带红色火焰 = 开，深灰色带灰色火焰 = 关。
    - 这个开关状态会保存在工作流里。开着 Align 保存，之后即使在全新的 ComfyUI 里打开也是开着的。
    - 每个工作流标签页各自独立。切换标签页，工具会跟着该标签页走（一个开一个关，不会混）。
    - 开关会算作对工作流的修改，所以会出现未保存的小圆点。
- 节点吸附到 **Node lines**，分组吸附到 **Group lines**。靠近时线会亮起来。
- 在经典画布和 **Nodes 2.0** 中都能用。
- **Snap distance** 就是 ComfyUI 自带的 **Snap to grid size**（Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas）。网格越小，吸附越紧。新线也会落在这个网格上。
    - 拖动时按 **Shift** 会把拖动交给 ComfyUI 自带的网格吸附（不吸附到线）。开启 **Always snap to grid** 时，在已被线吸住的那个轴上，线吸附仍然优先。

**Rulers**
- 默认：**开**
- Align 开启时，顶部和左侧边缘会显示标尺：
    - 在标尺上**左键点击**：添加一条 **Node line**（蓝色）。节点会吸附到它。
    - 在标尺上**右键点击**：添加一条 **Group line**（橙色）。分组会吸附到它。
    - 再次点击线的标记可删除。拖动标记可移动。
- 线会随工作流保存。

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- 默认：**120**
- 线一直不可见，直到光标或你拖动的东西靠近到这个距离。

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- 默认：**关**
- 开 = 还会吸附到其他节点的边缘和中心（这些不会显示线）。

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- 默认：**关**
- 拖动连线时，每个它能接入的接口都会以接口自己的颜色发光。
- 靠近时，接口会向外脉冲出圆环。越近 = 越大越亮。
- **Connection FX reach (px)：** 光标要靠多近圆环才开始出现。默认 160。
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%)：** 缩小视图时，每个有效接口会更亮，方便你找到。默认 60。
- 仅限经典画布。开启 **Nodes 2.0** 时它会自动避开。

---



---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Optimization report**
- 一个按钮。它会自己平移画布几秒钟，测量当前工作流里每个包的绘制和运行耗时，并扫描它们的文件。
- 你会得到一份拖慢画布的清单，最慢的排最前，分为：
    - **该包自己的设置**（确切的设置名、所在位置和当前值）
    - **LC123 优化设置**
    - **ComfyUI 设置**
    - **侧边栏标签页**
    - **功能必需**（没有设置项，这个包本来就是这样工作的）
- 只分析当前工作流里用到的节点包。
- 它建议的每个设置都会对照当前值检查：
    - ⚠️ 收益很大 · ✅ 值得的收益 · 💡 收益较小
    - ⚪ 已设置 · ➖ 不适用 · ℹ️ 必需，没有对应设置
- **Show last run：** 顶部的按钮可切换到上一份报告。每次新运行还会显示相比上次哪些变快了、哪些修复已经完成。
    - 只保留最近一次（刷新后仍在）。每次运行会替换它。
- 不会更改任何东西。（运行期间请保持鼠标不动。）
- 💡 在空白画布上右键菜单里也有。

---

### ⚡ Performance

这些只改变你在画布上看到的内容。生成、VRAM、**Save Image** 以及每个 **IMAGE** 输出都保持完整分辨率。（预览变轻不代表图像变轻。）

| 设置 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | 关 | 关闭 LC 图像 FX 节点上悬停的 A/B 擦除对比。最后一次的结果仍会显示。 |
| **Half-resolution previews** | 关 | 以一半大小绘制 FX 预览。平移时负担更轻。 |
| **Clamp longest side** | 关 | 缩小节点上的预览，让最长边适配 **Max edge**。 |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | 仅在 **Clamp longest side** 开启时使用。范围 256 到 2048。重型图表可试 512。 |
| **No preview when collapsed** | 开 | 折叠的 FX 节点不绘制预览。 |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | 关 | 隐藏所有 LC 图像 FX 预览。 |
| **Recent colors** | 开 | 在右键 **Colors** 菜单里保留你最近的 8 个自定义颜色。如果没装 Custom Scripts，会补上一个 Custom 取色器。 |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | 开 | 即使开了半分辨率或限制尺寸，**LC Skin Beauty** 仍保留完整质量预览，方便你放大看皮肤。Wipe 仍遵循 **Remove wipe**。 |
| **LoRA loader info button** | 开 | 在每个 **LC LoRA Loader** 行上显示 ℹ 按钮。触发词来自 LoRA 文件本身（无需联网）。关闭可让界面更简洁。 |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | 和节点文字一样，当你缩小到节点上的图像绘制尺寸小于这个值时，它就会关闭。较小的预览先关闭。0 = 始终绘制。 |

**从不受影响：** **LC Image Compare 🔎**、**LC Image Split 🖼️** 和 **LC Dynamic Overlay** 无论如何都保留完整预览和擦除对比（只有 **Preview distance** 会在缩得很小时把它们关闭）。

**推荐方案**
- **正常使用：** 全部保持默认。
- **图表卡顿：** 开启 **Half-resolution previews** 和 **Clamp longest side**（Max edge 512）。保持 **No preview when collapsed** 开启。
- **最轻量的画布：** 开启 **Hide FX on-node previews**。需要看前后对比时用 **Image Compare** 或 **Image Split**。
- 💡 修改会在下次重绘时生效。稍微平移一下画布即可，无需重启。

---

"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars

ja.text:
# LC123 Settings ⚙️

**どこにある?** **Settings**(歯車)を開き、**LC123 Settings ⚙️** を選びます。**Align**、**Connections**、**Notes**、**Optimization**、**Performance** の5つのセクションがあります。

- 💡 設定が見当たらない? ComfyUI を再起動してから **Ctrl+F5** を押し、ブラウザに新しいファイルを読み込ませてください。

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- デフォルト: **On**
- ツール全体のスイッチです。Off = 上部ツールバーの **Align** ボタン(LC ロゴ)も、以下の機能もすべてなくなります。
- オンにすると、**Align** ボタンで**開いているワークフロー**の Align をオン/オフできます。ライトグレーに赤い炎 = オン、ダークグレーにグレーの炎 = オフです。
    - そのオン/オフはワークフローに保存されます。Align をオンにして保存すれば、新しい ComfyUI でもオンで開きます。
    - ワークフローのタブごとに独立して保持されます。タブを切り替えると、ツールもそのタブに従います(片方でオン、もう片方でオフ、混ざることはありません)。
    - オン/オフの切り替えはワークフローの変更として扱われるので、未保存のドットが付きます。
- ノードは **Node lines** に、グループは **Group lines** にスナップします。近づくとラインが光ります。
- クラシックキャンバスでも **Nodes 2.0** でも動作します。
- **Snap distance** は ComfyUI 自体の **Snap to grid size**(Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas)です。グリッドが小さいほどスナップが細かくなります。新しいラインもそのグリッドに乗ります。
    - ドラッグ中に **Shift** を押すと、ドラッグが ComfyUI 自体のグリッドスナップに切り替わります(ラインスナップなし)。**Always snap to grid** がオンの場合でも、ラインに捕まった軸ではラインスナップが優先されます。

**Rulers**
- デフォルト: **On**
- Align がオンのとき、上端と左端にルーラーが表示されます:
    - ルーラーを**左クリック**: **Node line**(青)を追加します。ノードがスナップします。
    - ルーラーを**右クリック**: **Group line**(オレンジ)を追加します。グループがスナップします。
    - ラインのマーカーをもう一度クリックすると削除されます。マーカーをドラッグすると移動できます。
- ラインはワークフローと一緒に保存されます。

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- デフォルト: **120**
- カーソル、またはドラッグ中のものがこの距離まで近づくまで、ラインは見えません。

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- デフォルト: **Off**
- On = 他のノードの端や中心にもスナップします(それらのラインは表示されません)。

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- デフォルト: **Off**
- ワイヤーをドラッグしている間、接続可能なすべてのソケットが、そのソケットの色で光ります。
- 近づくと、ソケットからリングが波打ちます。近いほど大きく、明るくなります。
- **Connection FX reach (px):** リングが出始めるまでにカーソルがどれだけ近づく必要があるかです。デフォルトは 160。
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%):** ズームアウトしたとき、有効なソケットがより明るく光るので見つけやすくなります。デフォルトは 60。
- クラシックキャンバス専用です。**Nodes 2.0** がオンのときは邪魔をしません。

---



---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Optimization report**
- ボタンが1つあります。キャンバスを数秒間自動でパンし、開いているワークフロー内の各パックの描画と実行にかかる時間を計測し、そのファイルをスキャンします。
- キャンバスを重くしているものが、影響の大きい順にリストされ、次のように分類されます:
    - **そのパック自身の設定**(正確な設定名、その場所、現在の値)
    - **LC123 optimization settings**
    - **ComfyUI settings**
    - **Sidebar tabs**
    - **Required to function**(設定なし、そのパックの仕組み上必要なもの)
- 開いているワークフローで使われているノードパックだけが分析されます。
- 提案されるすべての設定は、現在の値と照合されます:
    - ⚠️ 大きな効果 · ✅ 価値のある効果 · 💡 小さな効果
    - ⚪ 設定済み · ➖ 該当なし · ℹ️ 必須、設定なし
- **Show last run:** 上部のボタンで前回のレポートに切り替わります。新しい実行のたびに、前回から速くなった点と、完了した修正も表示されます。
    - 保持されるのは最後の実行だけです(更新しても残ります)。実行のたびに置き換わります。
- 何も変更されません。(実行中はマウスを動かさないでください。)
- 💡 空のキャンバスを右クリックしたメニューにもあります。

---

### ⚡ Performance

これらはキャンバス上の見た目だけを変えます。生成、VRAM、**Save Image**、すべての **IMAGE** 出力はフル解像度のままです。(プレビューが軽くなっても、画像が軽くなることはありません。)

| Setting | Default | 機能 |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | LC image FX ノードのホバー A/B ワイプをオフにします。最後の結果は表示されたままです。 |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | FX プレビューを半分のサイズで描画します。パン中の負荷が減ります。 |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | ノード上のプレビューを、長辺が **Max edge** に収まるよう縮小します。 |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | **Clamp longest side** がオンのときだけ使われます。範囲は 256 から 2048。重いグラフでは 512 を試してください。 |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | 折りたたまれた FX ノードはプレビューを描画しません。 |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | すべての LC image FX プレビューを非表示にします。 |
| **Recent colors** | On | 右クリックの **Colors** メニューに、最後に使った8色のカスタムカラーを保持します。Custom Scripts がインストールされていない場合は、Custom ピッカーを追加します。 |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | half-res や clamp がオンでも **LC Skin Beauty** はフル品質のプレビューを保つので、肌にズームインして確認できます。ワイプは引き続き **Remove wipe** に従います。 |
| **LoRA loader info button** | On | **LC LoRA Loader** の各行に ℹ ボタンを表示します。トリガーワードは LoRA ファイル自体から取得します(インターネット不要)。オフにするとすっきりします。 |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | ノードのテキストと同じように、ノード上の画像は、この値より小さく描画されるほどズームアウトするとオフになります。小さいプレビューから先にオフになります。0 = 常に描画。 |

**影響を受けないもの:** **LC Image Compare 🔎**、**LC Image Split 🖼️**、**LC Dynamic Overlay** は、何があってもフルプレビューとワイプを保ちます(大きくズームアウトしたときだけ **Preview distance** でオフになります)。

**おすすめのセットアップ**
- **通常使い:** すべてデフォルトのままにします。
- **グラフが重いとき:** **Half-resolution previews** と **Clamp longest side**(Max edge 512)をオンにします。**No preview when collapsed** はオンのままにします。
- **キャンバスを最軽量にする:** **Hide FX on-node previews** をオンにします。Before/After を見たいときは **Image Compare** か **Image Split** を使います。
- 💡 変更は次の再描画で反映されます。キャンバスを少しパンするだけで、再起動は不要です。

---

"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars

ko.text:
# LC123 Settings ⚙️

**어디 있나요?** **Settings**(톱니바퀴)를 열고 **LC123 Settings ⚙️**로 가세요. 다섯 개 섹션이 있어요: **Align**, **Connections**, **Notes**, **Optimization**, **Performance**.

- 💡 설정이 안 보이나요? ComfyUI를 재시작한 다음 **Ctrl+F5**를 눌러 브라우저가 새 파일을 불러오게 하세요.

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- 기본값: **On**
- 도구 전체의 스위치예요. Off = 상단 툴바의 **Align** 버튼(LC 로고)과 아래 기능이 모두 사라져요.
- 켜 두면 **Align** 버튼이 **열려 있는 워크플로우**에 대해 Align을 켜고 끄요: 빨간 불꽃이 있는 밝은 회색 = 켜짐, 회색 불꽃이 있는 어두운 회색 = 꺼짐.
    - 켜짐/꺼짐은 워크플로우에 저장돼요. Align을 켠 채로 저장하면 새 ComfyUI에서도 Align이 켜진 채로 열려요.
    - 워크플로우 탭마다 따로 기억해요. 탭을 바꾸면 도구도 그 탭을 따라가요 (한쪽은 켜짐, 다른 쪽은 꺼짐, 헷갈릴 일 없어요).
    - 켜고 끄는 것도 워크플로우 변경으로 쳐서, 저장 안 됨 표시 점이 떠요.
- 노드는 **Node lines**에, 그룹은 **Group lines**에 스냅돼요. 가까워지면 선이 밝아져요.
- 클래식 캔버스와 **Nodes 2.0**에서 모두 작동해요.
- **Snap distance**는 ComfyUI 자체의 **Snap to grid size**(Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas)예요. 격자가 작을수록 더 촘촘하게 스냅돼요. 새 선도 그 격자에 맞춰져요.
    - 드래그하는 동안 **Shift**를 누르면 드래그가 ComfyUI 자체의 격자 스냅으로 넘어가요 (선 스냅 없음). **Always snap to grid**가 켜져 있어도, 선이 잡은 축에서는 선 스냅이 우선해요.

**Rulers**
- 기본값: **On**
- Align이 켜져 있는 동안 위쪽과 왼쪽 가장자리에 눈금자가 나타나요:
    - 눈금자를 **왼쪽 클릭**: **Node line**(파랑)을 추가해요. 노드가 거기에 스냅돼요.
    - 눈금자를 **오른쪽 클릭**: **Group line**(주황)을 추가해요. 그룹이 거기에 스냅돼요.
    - 선의 마커를 다시 클릭하면 삭제돼요. 마커를 끌면 옮겨요.
- 선은 워크플로우와 함께 저장돼요.

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- 기본값: **120**
- 커서나 끌고 있는 대상이 이 거리까지 가까워질 때까지 선은 보이지 않아요.

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- 기본값: **Off**
- On = 다른 노드의 가장자리와 중심에도 스냅돼요 (그쪽은 선이 표시되지 않아요).

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- 기본값: **Off**
- 선을 끄는 동안, 연결할 수 있는 모든 소켓이 자기 소켓 색으로 빛나요.
- 가까이 가면 소켓에서 링이 퍼져 나와요. 가까울수록 더 크고 밝아요.
- **Connection FX reach (px):** 링이 시작되려면 커서가 얼마나 가까워야 하는지. 기본값 160.
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%):** 줌 아웃하면 유효한 모든 소켓이 더 밝게 빛나서 찾기 쉬워요. 기본값 60.
- 클래식 캔버스 전용이에요. **Nodes 2.0**이 켜져 있으면 작동하지 않아요.

---



---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Optimization report**
- 버튼 하나예요. 캔버스를 몇 초 동안 알아서 이동시키면서, 열려 있는 워크플로우의 모든 팩이 그리고 실행하는 것의 시간을 재고 파일을 스캔해요.
- 캔버스를 느리게 만드는 것의 목록이 큰 순서대로 나오고, 다음처럼 분류돼요:
    - **해당 팩 자체의 설정** (정확한 설정 이름, 위치, 현재 값)
    - **LC123 optimization settings**
    - **ComfyUI settings**
    - **사이드바 탭**
    - **작동에 필요한 것** (설정 없음, 그 팩이 원래 그렇게 작동해요)
- 열려 있는 워크플로우에서 쓰는 노드 팩만 분석해요.
- 제안하는 모든 설정은 현재 값과 대조해서 확인해요:
    - ⚠️ 큰 효과 · ✅ 할 만한 효과 · 💡 작은 효과
    - ⚪ 이미 설정됨 · ➖ 해당 없음 · ℹ️ 필수, 설정 없음
- **Show last run:** 맨 위 버튼으로 이전 리포트로 전환해요. 새로 실행할 때마다 지난번 이후 무엇이 빨라졌고 어떤 수정이 끝났는지도 보여줘요.
    - 마지막 실행만 보관돼요 (새로고침해도 유지). 실행할 때마다 덮어써요.
- 아무것도 바꾸지 않아요. (실행 중에는 마우스를 가만히 두세요.)
- 💡 빈 캔버스를 우클릭한 메뉴에도 있어요.

---

### ⚡ Performance

캔버스에 보이는 것만 바꿔요. 생성, VRAM, **Save Image**, 모든 **IMAGE** 출력은 전체 해상도 그대로예요. (가벼운 미리보기가 가벼운 이미지를 뜻하지는 않아요.)

| 설정 | 기본값 | 기능 |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | LC 이미지 FX 노드의 hover A/B 와이프를 꺼요. 마지막 결과는 그대로 보여요. |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | FX 미리보기를 절반 크기로 그려요. 캔버스를 움직일 때 부담이 줄어요. |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | 노드 위 미리보기를 줄여서 가장 긴 변이 **Max edge**에 맞게 해요. |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | **Clamp longest side**가 켜져 있을 때만 사용돼요. 범위 256에서 2048. 무거운 그래프에서는 512를 써 보세요. |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | 접힌 FX 노드는 미리보기를 그리지 않아요. |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | LC 이미지 FX 미리보기를 전부 숨겨요. |
| **Recent colors** | On | 우클릭 **Colors** 메뉴에 최근 사용한 사용자 색 8개를 보관해요. Custom Scripts가 설치되어 있지 않으면 Custom 선택기를 추가해요. |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | half-res나 clamp가 켜져 있어도 **LC Skin Beauty**는 전체 품질 미리보기를 유지해서 피부를 확대해서 볼 수 있어요. 와이프는 계속 **Remove wipe**를 따라요. |
| **LoRA loader info button** | On | 각 **LC LoRA Loader** 행에 ℹ 버튼을 표시해요. 트리거 단어는 LoRA 파일 자체에서 가져와요 (인터넷 불필요). 깔끔하게 보려면 끄세요. |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | 노드 텍스트처럼, 노드 위 이미지는 이 값보다 작게 그려질 만큼 줌 아웃하면 꺼져요. 작은 미리보기부터 먼저 꺼져요. 0 = 항상 그림. |

**영향받지 않는 것:** **LC Image Compare 🔎**, **LC Image Split 🖼️**, **LC Dynamic Overlay**는 어떤 설정이든 전체 미리보기와 와이프를 유지해요 (많이 줌 아웃했을 때 **Preview distance**만 이들을 꺼요).

**추천 설정**
- **일반 사용:** 전부 기본값으로 두세요.
- **그래프가 버벅일 때:** **Half-resolution previews**와 **Clamp longest side**(Max edge 512)를 켜세요. **No preview when collapsed**는 켜 두세요.
- **가장 가벼운 캔버스:** **Hide FX on-node previews**를 켜세요. before/after를 봐야 할 때는 **Image Compare**나 **Image Split**을 쓰세요.
- 💡 변경은 다음 redraw 때 적용돼요. 캔버스를 살짝 움직이면 되고, 재시작은 필요 없어요.

---

"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars

widgets_values:
# LC123 Settings ⚙️

**Where are they?** Open **Settings** (the gear), then **LC123 Settings ⚙️**. There are five sections: **Align**, **Connections**, **Notes**, **Optimization** and **Performance**.

- 💡 Missing a setting? Restart ComfyUI, then press **Ctrl+F5** so the browser loads the new files.

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- Default: **On**
- The switch for the whole tool. Off = no **Align** button (the LC logo) in the top toolbar and none of the features below.
- With it on, the **Align** button turns Align on or off **for the open workflow**: light gray with the red flame = on, dark gray with a gray flame = off.
    - That on/off is saved in the workflow. Save it with Align on and it opens with Align on, even on a fresh ComfyUI.
    - Every workflow tab keeps its own. Switch tabs and the tool follows that tab (on in one, off in the other, no mix-ups).
    - Turning it on or off counts as a change to the workflow, so you get the unsaved dot.
- Nodes snap to **Node lines**, groups snap to **Group lines**. A line lights up when you get close.
- Works on the classic canvas and in **Nodes 2.0**.
- **Snap distance** is ComfyUI's own **Snap to grid size** (Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas). Smaller grid = tighter snap. New lines land on that grid too.
    - **Shift** while dragging hands the drag to ComfyUI's own grid snap (no line snap). With **Always snap to grid** on, a line snap still wins on the axis it caught.

**Rulers**
- Default: **On**
- Rulers on the top and left edge while Align is on:
    - **Left click** a ruler: adds a **Node line** (blue). Nodes snap to it.
    - **Right click** a ruler: adds a **Group line** (orange). Groups snap to it.
    - Click a line's marker again to remove it. Drag a marker to move it.
- Lines save with the workflow.

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- Default: **120**
- Lines stay invisible until the cursor or whatever you drag gets this close.

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- Default: **Off**
- On = also snap to other nodes' edges and centers (no line is shown for those).

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- Default: **Off**
- While you drag a wire, every socket it can plug into glows in its socket color.
- Get close and rings pulse out of the socket. Closer = bigger and brighter.
- **Connection FX reach (px):** how close the cursor has to be before the rings start. Default 160.
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%):** zoomed out, every valid socket glows brighter so you can find it. Default 60.
- Classic canvas only. With **Nodes 2.0** on it stays out of the way.

---



---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Optimization report**
- One button. It pans the canvas by itself for a few seconds, times what every pack in the open workflow draws and runs, and scans their files.
- You get a list of what slows your canvas down, biggest first, sorted into:
    - **That pack's own settings** (the exact setting name, where it lives and its current value)
    - **LC123 optimization settings**
    - **ComfyUI settings**
    - **Sidebar tabs**
    - **Required to function** (no setting, it is how that pack works)
- Only node packs used in the open workflow are analyzed.
- Every setting it suggests is checked against its current value:
    - ⚠️ big gain · ✅ worthwhile gain · 💡 small gain
    - ⚪ already set · ➖ does not apply · ℹ️ required, no setting for it
- **Show last run:** the button at the top flips to the previous report. Each new run also shows what got faster and which fixes are done since last time.
    - Only the last run is kept (it survives a refresh). Each run replaces it.
- Nothing is changed. (Keep the mouse still while it runs.)
- 💡 Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.

---

### ⚡ Performance

These only change what you see on the canvas. Generation, VRAM, **Save Image** and every **IMAGE** output stay full resolution. (A lighter preview never means a lighter image.)

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | Turns off the hover A/B wipe on LC image FX nodes. The last result still shows. |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | Draws FX previews at half size. Less work while panning. |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | Shrinks on-node previews so the longest side fits **Max edge**. |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | Only used when **Clamp longest side** is on. Range 256 to 2048. Try 512 on heavy graphs. |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | Collapsed FX nodes skip drawing their preview. |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hides every LC image FX preview. |
| **Recent colors** | On | Keeps your last 8 custom colors in the right-click **Colors** menu. Adds a Custom picker if Custom Scripts is not installed. |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | **LC Skin Beauty** keeps a full-quality preview even with half-res or clamp on, so you can still zoom into skin. Wipe still follows **Remove wipe**. |
| **LoRA loader info button** | On | Shows the ℹ button on each **LC LoRA Loader** row. Trigger words come from the LoRA file itself (no internet). Turn off to declutter. |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | Like node text, an on-node image switches off when you zoom out far enough that it is drawn smaller than this. Smaller previews switch off first. 0 = always draw. |

**Never affected:** **LC Image Compare 🔎**, **LC Image Split 🖼️** and **LC Dynamic Overlay** keep their full preview and wipe no matter what (only **Preview distance** switches them off when zoomed far out).

**Suggested setups**
- **Normal use:** leave everything at default.
- **Laggy graph:** turn on **Half-resolution previews** and **Clamp longest side** (Max edge 512). Keep **No preview when collapsed** on.
- **Lightest canvas:** turn on **Hide FX on-node previews**. Use **Image Compare** or **Image Split** when you need to see a before/after.
- 💡 Changes apply on the next redraw. Pan the canvas a little, no restart needed.

---

# LC123 Settings ⚙️

**Where are they?** Open **Settings** (the gear), then **LC123 Settings ⚙️**. There are five sections: **Align**, **Connections**, **Notes**, **Optimization** and **Performance**.

- 💡 Missing a setting? Restart ComfyUI, then press **Ctrl+F5** so the browser loads the new files.

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- Default: **On**
- The switch for the whole tool. Off = no **Align** button (the LC logo) in the top toolbar and none of the features below.
- With it on, the **Align** button turns Align on or off **for the open workflow**: light gray with the red flame = on, dark gray with a gray flame = off.
    - That on/off is saved in the workflow. Save it with Align on and it opens with Align on, even on a fresh ComfyUI.
    - Every workflow tab keeps its own. Switch tabs and the tool follows that tab (on in one, off in the other, no mix-ups).
    - Turning it on or off counts as a change to the workflow, so you get the unsaved dot.
- Nodes snap to **Node lines**, groups snap to **Group lines**. A line lights up when you get close.
- Works on the classic canvas and in **Nodes 2.0**.
- **Snap distance** is ComfyUI's own **Snap to grid size** (Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas). Smaller grid = tighter snap. New lines land on that grid too.
    - **Shift** while dragging hands the drag to ComfyUI's own grid snap (no line snap). With **Always snap to grid** on, a line snap still wins on the axis it caught.

**Rulers**
- Default: **On**
- Rulers on the top and left edge while Align is on:
    - **Left click** a ruler: adds a **Node line** (blue). Nodes snap to it.
    - **Right click** a ruler: adds a **Group line** (orange). Groups snap to it.
    - Click a line's marker again to remove it. Drag a marker to move it.
- Lines save with the workflow.

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- Default: **120**
- Lines stay invisible until the cursor or whatever you drag gets this close.

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- Default: **Off**
- On = also snap to other nodes' edges and centers (no line is shown for those).

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- Default: **Off**
- While you drag a wire, every socket it can plug into glows in its socket color.
- Get close and rings pulse out of the socket. Closer = bigger and brighter.
- **Connection FX reach (px):** how close the cursor has to be before the rings start. Default 160.
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%):** zoomed out, every valid socket glows brighter so you can find it. Default 60.
- Classic canvas only. With **Nodes 2.0** on it stays out of the way.

---



---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Optimization report**
- One button. It pans the canvas by itself for a few seconds, times what every pack in the open workflow draws and runs, and scans their files.
- You get a list of what slows your canvas down, biggest first, sorted into:
    - **That pack's own settings** (the exact setting name, where it lives and its current value)
    - **LC123 optimization settings**
    - **ComfyUI settings**
    - **Sidebar tabs**
    - **Required to function** (no setting, it is how that pack works)

en.text:
# Instructions

---

@[card: Follow me](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: Follow me](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: Buy me a ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### This is many hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍 like, 💬 comment, and feel free to ⚡ tip 😉

---

## General
# 🛑🚫✋ Do not manually bypass anything. There are switches for everything.

### ⚠️ If you get a `NoneType` error, it is the ControlNet switches, no image in I2I or mask, or no sampler turned on.

### 💾 Save info
- NOTHING SAVES UNLESS IT IS TURNED ON.
- 📂 Folder labels are in the **Save Group** if you want to change them.
- **Save Post Process** writes the final image **without** metadata. Use that to enter resources by hand on CivitAI if the checkpoint does not show up.

## Model links

For BF16 and NVFP4 variants, see [Comfy-Org/Krea-2](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2)

**diffusion_models**
- [krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/diffusion_models/krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors)
- [Krea2_turbo_bf16](https://civitai.red/api/download/models/3064584?fileId=2943406)
- [krea2_raw](https://huggingface.co/krea/Krea-2-Raw/resolve/main/raw.safetensors?download=true)
- [Krealism](https://civitai.red/models/2786809/krealism?modelVersionId=3139976)
- [Animosity](https://civitai.red/models/2596298/animosity)
- [GGUF version](https://civitai.red/api/download/models/3069586?fileId=2948449). ⚠️ Do not use the other GGUFs on CivitAI. They are garbage.

**text_encoders**
- [qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors)
- NSFW [qwen3vl_4b_Heretic](https://civitai.red/api/download/models/3066989?fileId=2945735)

**vae**
- [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors)
- [Krea2_real_vae](https://civitai.red/api/download/models/3068442?fileId=2947164)

**🖌️Anypaint LoRA**
- [krea2_anypaint LoRA](https://huggingface.co/yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint/resolve/main/krea2_anypaint_rank32.safetensors?download=true)

**🪪 Edit LoRA**

- [krea2_identity_edit_v2](https://huggingface.co/conradlocke/krea2-identity-edit/resolve/main/krea2_identity_edit_v2_r128.safetensors?download=true)
- other versions available [here](https://huggingface.co/conradlocke/krea2-identity-edit/tree/main)

**ControlNet LoRA**
- [Krea 2 depth ControlNet LoRA](https://huggingface.co/Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet/resolve/main/depth-control-lora.safetensors?download=true)

**Krea 2 Conditioning Rebalance**
- Removes the safety filter for NSFW [HERE](https://github.com/nova452/ComfyUI-ConditioningKrea2Rebalance)

**LC-123 node repo**
- [https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

### I2I and Florence prompt generator
- ⚠️ I2I and Florence must **both** be on to use I2I.
- **Background removal** helps if you do not want the background in the prompt or in the ControlNet. Read the instructions in that group.
- ⚠️ Turn off **text remove** if you are removing the background but **not** using Florence, or you will get a “text” error.
- ControlNet also uses the **I2I** image, so I2I must be on.

### Prompt enhancer **Qwen 📝🪄**
- Use the **Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct** version.
- Pruned LLM that rewrites your prompt. Put the instructions in the node.
- Prompt length strongly affects speed. Two instruction templates are in **Notes**.
- 💡 If the model will not load or cannot be found, follow [these instructions](https://github.com/huchukato/ComfyUI-QwenVL-Mod).

### Upscale tips
- Low VRAM: keep aspect ratio small and run **SEEDVR2** on the other side.
- **Prescale:** the Aspect Ratio control grows the generation. The slider is for Hi-Rez Fix.
- **Tiled vs not tiled:** tiling splits the image, much faster, small quality cost. Set tile size as high as VRAM allows.

### Hi-Rez upscale
- Realism: UltraSharp, Nickelback, or ESRGAN.
- Anime: AnimeSharp.
- Low VRAM: use the slider at the bottom. It adds tiles by shrinking tile size. Use it only to stop OOM / brick-ups.
- [Upscale models](https://huggingface.co/uwg/upscaler/tree/main/ESRGAN)
- Noise from bad LoRAs: this denoise model cleans a bit better. [Denoise model](https://github.com/cszn/KAIR/releases/download/v1.0/scunet_color_real_gan.pth)

### File locations

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── qwen_image_vae.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── (all LoRAs)
│   ├── 📂 luts/
│   │   └── (LUT files)
│   ├── 📂 ultralytics/
│   │   └── 📂 segm/
│   │       └── (detection files)
│   └── 📂 upscale_models/
│       └── (ESRGAN, Nickelback, etc.)
```

### I2I と Florence プロンプトジェネレーター
- ⚠️ I2I を使うには、I2I と Florence の**両方**がオンである必要があります。
- **Background removal** は、背景をプロンプトや ControlNet に含めたくないときに役立ちます。そのグループ内の説明を読んでください。
- ⚠️ 背景を削除するのに Florence を**使わない**場合は **text remove** をオフにしてください。そうしないと “text” エラーになります。
- ControlNet も **I2I** の画像を使うので、I2I をオンにしておく必要があります。

### プロンプトエンハンサー **Qwen 📝🪄**
- **Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct** 版を使ってください。
- プロンプトを書き換える軽量化(pruned)LLM です。指示はノードの中に入れます。
- プロンプトの長さは速度に大きく影響します。2つの指示テンプレートが **Notes** に入っています。
- 💡 モデルが読み込めない、または見つからない場合は、[こちらの手順](https://github.com/huchukato/ComfyUI-QwenVL-Mod)に従ってください。

### アップスケールのコツ
- 低 VRAM: アスペクト比を小さく保ち、反対側で **SEEDVR2** を実行します。
- **Prescale:** Aspect Ratio のコントロールで生成サイズを大きくします。スライダーは Hi-Rez Fix 用です。
- **Tiled と非 tiled:** tiling は画像を分割するので、はるかに高速ですが、品質が少し落ちます。タイルサイズは VRAM が許す限り大きくしてください。

### Hi-Rez upscale
- リアル系: UltraSharp、Nickelback、または ESRGAN。
- アニメ: AnimeSharp。
- 低 VRAM: 一番下のスライダーを使います。タイルサイズを小さくしてタイル数を増やします。OOM やフリーズを防ぐときだけ使ってください。
- [Upscale models](https://huggingface.co/uwg/upscaler/tree/main/ESRGAN)
- 質の悪い LoRA によるノイズ: この denoise モデルのほうが少しきれいに除去できます。[Denoise model](https://github.com/cszn/KAIR/releases/download/v1.0/scunet_color_real_gan.pth)

```
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors

│   │   └── qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
```

```
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── (all LoRAs)
│   ├── 📂 luts/
│   │   └── (LUT files)
│   ├── 📂 ultralytics/
│   │   └── 📂 segm/
│   │       └── (detection files)
│   └── 📂 upscale_models/
│       └── (ESRGAN, Nickelback, etc.)
```

nodes.title: 💡Tips & Tricks

en.text:
## 💡Tips & Tricks:

What I do...😼

**📝 Prompting:**
- I typically start with an idea, write it in the prompt box, then run it through the enhancer.
- or... I'll run an image through Florence and get the prompt.
- then I'll cut & paste it back into the prompt box and edit it. 

**Steps:**
- I'll typically run every model at the very top range or a few steps over what is recommended. Too many steps overbake it. For Krea2 Turbo, I use 10-12

**🖼️ to 👠👗style, 🎭mask, 🥅 controlnet**
- quality is everything. 🗑️garbage in, 🗑️ garbage out.
- ⚠️ understand the limits of each models controlnet before getting angry with it. Krea2 is designed in a way that does not play nice with controlnet, and currently we are limited to only one set of weights and one type: depth. **It is hit or miss.** I use it to get close. If I want precision, I'll use Flux.
- 👗👠 Using two styles is cool, but a little difficult to control. I always give you options, but I never use more than one image. 
   - 💡 I purposely made it use Image 2 and 3 so that you can still put an image in the first slot for a prompt.

**Settings** 
- I have a set of schedulers and samplers that I like. I use them over and over again and only change them for different styles:
- **regular:**
   - Res_2m/ Beta57 (or bong tangent)
   - Euler/ Simple
   - dpmpp_2m_sde/ sgm_uniform
- **🤡Sampler selector**
   - fully_implicit/radau_iii-3s (or 4s) + Bong tangent or simple

**Sigmas**
- I literally just built this thing. It was anightmare. I'm still messing with it?
- my best settings? Whatever I shipped it with. I have a lot to mess with here. 
- Please share what you learn. 

**Detailer Daemon**
- This is really set and forget with me. On or off once I have it locked in.  

**Hi Res Fix/ Ultimate Upscaler**
- I never upscale past 2.0
- Skin and detail can be a big help here. 
   - siax_200
   - skin_diff_lite
   - foolhardy
- **Anime:** Anime sharp
- **Graphics:** any superscale. I like Nickelback

**🚫NSFW Detailers**
- short of nipples, I have yet to find a reason to use these on Krea2. 

**Detailers**
- I never combine face with eyes. I'll just use face 9 times out of 10 unless I want something special with the eyes

**Seed VR2**
- This collects dust. I use it for commercial or commission graphics. 
   - That being said, I used it a lot when I had lower VRAM. Mainly because pushing the upscaled version through the detailers was VRAM prohibitive.
- for almost any image in everyday use or on the site. The ultimate upscaler is usually enough.

**🎨 Post processing**
- of the ones on the top line, I really only use Contrast adaptive sharpen every day. The others are for when I am trying to get a certain effect
- **Image filter** is your friend. I always leave it a little low on bright and a little high on saturation
- **Optical Realism 📷, 📷 Lens FX, 🔬 Clarity FX.** These are all for realism. 
   - I vary between them. For example, I use several different model and LoRA combinations. One works better for one set, the other for another. 
   - 💡 Never use optical realism and Lens FX at the same time. They get in a cage match. 
- **LUT** My all time favorite. It really can make an image. I like *Cool_Natural_Breeze*

zh.text:
## 💡技巧与窍门：

我是怎么做的...😼

**📝 提示词：**
- 我通常先有一个想法，写进提示词框，然后用增强器跑一遍。
- 或者...我把一张图丢给 Florence 得到提示词。
- 然后把它复制粘贴回提示词框里再编辑。 

**步数：**
- 我通常把每个模型都跑在推荐范围的最高端，或者比推荐值多几步。步数太多会过烘焙。对于 Krea2 Turbo，我用 10-12

**🖼️ 转 👠👗风格、🎭mask、🥅 controlnet**
- 质量就是一切。🗑️垃圾进，🗑️垃圾出。
- ⚠️ 在对每个模型的 controlnet 发火之前，先了解它的局限。Krea2 的设计和 controlnet 不太合得来，目前我们只有一套权重和一种类型：depth。**成不成全看运气。**我用它来接近目标。如果我要精确，就用 Flux。
- 👗👠 同时使用两种风格很酷，但有点难控制。我总是给你多种选择，但我从不使用超过一张图。 
   - 💡 我特意让它使用 Image 2 和 3，这样你仍然可以在第一个槽位放一张图来配合提示词。

**设置** 
- 我有一套自己喜欢的 scheduler 和 sampler。我一遍又一遍地用它们，只有换风格时才改：
- **常规：**
   - Res_2m/ Beta57（或 bong tangent）
   - Euler/ Simple
   - dpmpp_2m_sde/ sgm_uniform
- **🤡Sampler selector**
   - fully_implicit/radau_iii-3s（或 4s）+ Bong tangent 或 simple

**Sigmas**
- 我真的是刚做出来这个东西。简直是噩梦。我还在摸索？
- 我最好的设置？就是我发布时附带的那套。这里有很多可以玩的东西。 
- 请分享你的心得。 

**Detailer Daemon**
- 这个对我来说基本是设好就不管了。锁定之后，开或关就行。  

**Hi Res Fix/ Ultimate Upscaler**
- 我从不放大超过 2.0
- 皮肤和细节在这里可以帮上大忙。 
   - siax_200
   - skin_diff_lite
   - foolhardy
- **动漫：**Anime sharp
- **图形：**任何 superscale。我喜欢 Nickelback

**🚫NSFW Detailers**
- 除了乳头，我还没发现在 Krea2 上有什么理由用这些。 

**Detailers**
- 我从不把 face 和 eyes 合在一起。除非想对眼睛做点特别的，否则十次里有九次我只用 face

**Seed VR2**
- 这个一直在吃灰。我用它做商业或委托的图形。 
   - 话虽如此，我在 VRAM 比较小的时候用得很多。主要是因为把放大后的版本再送去 detailer 在 VRAM 上不可行。
- 对于日常使用或发到网站上的几乎所有图像，Ultimate Upscaler 通常就够了。

**🎨 后期处理**
- 顶行那些里，我每天真正会用的只有 Contrast adaptive sharpen。其他的是我想要某种特定效果时才用
- **Image filter** 是你的朋友。我总是把 bright 调得稍低一点，saturation 调得稍高一点
- **Optical Realism 📷、📷 Lens FX、🔬 Clarity FX。**这些都是为了写实。 
   - 我会在它们之间切换。比如，我会使用好几种不同的模型和 LoRA 组合。这个对某一组更好，那个对另一组更好。 
   - 💡 永远不要同时使用 optical realism 和 Lens FX。它们会打起笼中格斗。 
- **LUT** 我永远的最爱。它真的能成就一张图。我喜欢 *Cool_Natural_Breeze*

ja.text:
## 💡ヒントとコツ:

私がやっていること…😼

**📝 プロンプト:**
- たいていは、アイデアから始めて、プロンプト欄に書き、エンハンサーに通します。
- あるいは…画像を Florence に通してプロンプトを取り出します。
- それをプロンプト欄にコピペして戻し、手を入れます。 

**Steps:**
- どのモデルも、推奨の最上限か、それより数ステップ多めで回すのが普通です。ステップが多すぎると焼きすぎになります。Krea2 Turbo では 10-12 を使っています

**🖼️ to 👠👗style、🎭mask、🥅 controlnet**
- 質がすべてです。🗑️入れたゴミは、🗑️ゴミとして出てきます。
- ⚠️ 各モデルの controlnet の限界を理解してから、怒ってください。Krea2 は controlnet と相性が良くない作りで、今のところ重みは1セット、種類は depth だけに限られています。**当たり外れがあります。** 私はざっくり近づけるために使っています。精密さが欲しいときは Flux を使います。
- 👗👠 スタイルを2つ使うのはカッコいいですが、少し制御が難しいです。選択肢は常に用意していますが、私は画像を1枚より多くは使いません。 
   - 💡 Image 2 と 3 を使うようにわざと作ってあるので、1番目のスロットにはプロンプト用の画像を入れておけます。

**設定** 
- 気に入っているスケジューラーとサンプラーのセットがあります。何度も使い回していて、スタイルが違うときだけ変えます:
- **通常:**
   - Res_2m/ Beta57 (または bong tangent)
   - Euler/ Simple
   - dpmpp_2m_sde/ sgm_uniform
- **🤡Sampler selector**
   - fully_implicit/radau_iii-3s (または 4s) + Bong tangent か simple

**Sigmas**
- ついさっき作ったばかりです。悪夢でした。まだいじっています?
- 私のベストの設定? 出荷時のままです。ここは試すことがたくさんあります。 
- 分かったことを共有してください。 

**Detailer Daemon**
- これは完全に、設定したら放置です。決まったらオンかオフかだけ。  

**Hi Res Fix/ Ultimate Upscaler**
- 2.0 より大きくはアップスケールしません
- 肌とディテールにはここがかなり効きます。 
   - siax_200
   - skin_diff_lite
   - foolhardy
- **アニメ:** Anime sharp
- **グラフィック:** どの superscale でもOK。私は Nickelback が好きです

**🚫NSFW Detailers**
- 乳首を除けば、Krea2 でこれらを使う理由はまだ見つかっていません。 

**ディテーラー**
- 顔と目は組み合わせません。目で特別なことをしたいとき以外は、10回中9回は顔だけを使います

**Seed VR2**
- ホコリをかぶっています。商用や依頼のグラフィック用に使っています。 
   - とはいえ、VRAM が少なかった頃はよく使っていました。主に、アップスケール版をディテーラーに通すのが VRAM 的に厳しかったからです。
- 日常で使う画像やサイト用のほとんどの画像には、Ultimate Upscaler で十分です。

**🎨 ポストプロセス**
- 一番上の行のうち、毎日使うのは Contrast adaptive sharpen くらいです。他は、特定の効果を狙うときのものです
- **Image filter** は味方です。いつも、brightness は少し低め、saturation は少し高めにしています
- **Optical Realism 📷、📷 Lens FX、🔬 Clarity FX。** これらはどれもリアル系用です。 
   - 使い分けています。たとえば、モデルと LoRA の組み合わせをいろいろ使うので、あるセットにはこれ、別のセットにはあれ、という具合です。 
   - 💡 Optical realism と Lens FX は絶対に同時に使わないでください。ケージマッチになります。 
- **LUT** 昔から一番のお気に入りです。画像を本当に変えられます。私は *Cool_Natural_Breeze* が好きです

ko.text:
## 💡팁과 요령:

제가 하는 방식...😼

**📝 프롬프트 작성:**
- 보통 아이디어에서 시작해 프롬프트 상자에 쓰고, enhancer에 통과시킵니다.
- 아니면... 이미지를 Florence에 넣어서 프롬프트를 뽑습니다.
- 그다음 프롬프트 상자에 붙여 넣고 편집합니다. 

**Steps:**
- 보통 모든 모델을 권장 범위의 맨 위쪽, 또는 권장보다 몇 step 더 높게 돌립니다. step이 너무 많으면 과하게 구워집니다. Krea2 Turbo는 10-12를 씁니다

**🖼️ to 👠👗style, 🎭mask, 🥅 controlnet**
- 품질이 전부입니다. 🗑️쓰레기를 넣으면 🗑️쓰레기가 나옵니다.
- ⚠️ 화내기 전에 각 모델의 controlnet 한계를 이해하세요. Krea2는 controlnet과 잘 맞지 않는 구조이고, 지금은 가중치가 한 세트, 종류도 depth 하나뿐입니다. **될 때도 있고 안 될 때도 있습니다.** 저는 비슷하게 잡는 용도로 씁니다. 정밀함이 필요하면 Flux를 씁니다.
- 👗👠 스타일을 두 개 쓰는 건 멋지지만 조절이 좀 어렵습니다. 선택지는 항상 드리지만, 저는 이미지를 한 장 넘게 쓰지 않습니다. 
   - 💡 일부러 Image 2와 3을 쓰게 만들어서, 첫 번째 슬롯에는 프롬프트용 이미지를 그대로 넣을 수 있게 했습니다.

**설정** 
- 제가 좋아하는 scheduler와 sampler 세트가 있습니다. 계속 반복해서 쓰고, 스타일이 다를 때만 바꿉니다:
- **일반:**
   - Res_2m/ Beta57 (또는 bong tangent)
   - Euler/ Simple
   - dpmpp_2m_sde/ sgm_uniform
- **🤡Sampler selector**
   - fully_implicit/radau_iii-3s (또는 4s) + Bong tangent 또는 simple

**Sigmas**
- 방금 만든 따끈따끈한 물건입니다. 악몽이었습니다. 아직도 만지작거리는 중?
- 최고의 설정이요? 출시할 때 넣어 둔 값입니다. 만져 볼 게 많습니다. 
- 알아낸 게 있으면 공유해 주세요. 

**Detailer Daemon**
- 저한테는 정말 한 번 맞추면 끝입니다. 값이 정해지면 켜거나 끌 뿐입니다.  

**Hi Res Fix/ Ultimate Upscaler**
- 2.0 넘게는 절대 업스케일하지 않습니다
- 피부와 디테일에 큰 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 
   - siax_200
   - skin_diff_lite
   - foolhardy
- **애니메이션:** Anime sharp
- **그래픽:** 아무 superscale. 저는 Nickelback이 좋습니다

**🚫NSFW 디테일러**
- 유두를 빼면 Krea2에서 이걸 쓸 이유를 아직 못 찾았습니다. 

**디테일러**
- 얼굴과 눈을 같이 쓰지 않습니다. 눈에 특별한 걸 하고 싶지 않다면 10번 중 9번은 얼굴만 씁니다

**Seed VR2**
- 먼지만 쌓입니다. 상업용이나 의뢰받은 그래픽에 씁니다. 
   - 그렇다고는 해도 VRAM이 적을 때는 많이 썼습니다. 주로 업스케일한 결과를 디테일러에 통과시키는 게 VRAM상 불가능했기 때문입니다.
- 일상적으로 쓰는 거의 모든 이미지나 사이트용으로는 보통 ultimate upscaler로 충분합니다.

**🎨 후처리**
- 맨 윗줄에 있는 것 중 매일 쓰는 건 Contrast adaptive sharpen뿐입니다. 나머지는 특정 효과를 낼 때 씁니다
- **Image filter**는 친구입니다. 저는 항상 brightness는 조금 낮게, saturation은 조금 높게 둡니다
- **Optical Realism 📷, 📷 Lens FX, 🔬 Clarity FX.** 모두 사실감을 위한 것입니다. 
   - 이것들을 번갈아 씁니다. 예를 들어 저는 여러 모델과 LoRA 조합을 쓰는데, 어떤 조합에는 이게, 다른 조합에는 저게 더 잘 맞습니다. 
   - 💡 optical realism과 Lens FX를 동시에 쓰지 마세요. 서로 케이지 매치를 벌입니다.
- **LUT** 영원한 최애입니다. 이미지를 정말 살려 줍니다. 저는 *Cool_Natural_Breeze*를 좋아합니다

   - That being said, I used it a lot when I had lower VRAM. Mainly because pushing the upscaled version through the detailers was VRAM prohibitive.
- for almost any image in everyday use or on the site. The ultimate upscaler is usually enough.

**🎨 Post processing**
- of the ones on the top line, I really only use Contrast adaptive sharpen every day. The others are for when I am trying to get a certain effect
- **Image filter** is your friend. I always leave it a little low on bright and a little high on saturation
- **Optical Realism 📷, 📷 Lens FX, 🔬 Clarity FX.** These are all for realism. 
   - I vary between them. For example, I use several different model and LoRA combinations. One works better for one set, the other for another. 
   - 💡 Never use optical realism and Lens FX at the same time. They get in a cage match. 
- **LUT** My all time favorite. It really can make an image. I like *Cool_Natural_Breeze*

nodes.title: LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝

en.text:
## LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ This auto downloads the model you choose on the first run, so it will take several minutes.
- The model selector shows your already downloaded options as well as available downloads.
- n_ctx. Lower numbers mean less vram when loading...and less quality.
- batch_max_tokens. Lower this to save on VRAM, but again you mess with quality

**LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝**:
- Write your rough `prompt_text`, then pick a preset.
   - **Enhance**: adds detail, keeps your original intent.
   - **Refine**: cleans up wording and structure, adds nothing new.
   - **Creative Rewrite**: reimagines the scene around your subject.
   - **Detailed Visual**: maxes out concrete visual detail for photoreal output.
- Text-only, no image or video input needed. It works straight off the prompt.
- ⚠️ **Custom** preset needs an actual system prompt in `custom_system_prompt`. Leave it blank and it errors.
- 💡 **style_tag** locks the rewrite to a specific visual style on top of whatever the preset already does.

- 💡 **style_tag** 在预设功能基础上，锁定重写结果为特定视觉风格。

ja.text:
## LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ このノードは最初の実行時に選択したモデルを自動でダウンロードするため、数分かかることがあります。

   - **Refine**: 文の言い回しや構造を整理し、新しい要素は追加しません。
   - **Creative Rewrite**: あなたの主体を中心にシーンを再構想します。
   - **Detailed Visual**: フォトリアリズム出力に向けた具体的な視覚的ディテールを最大限に強調します。
- 画像や動画入力を必要とせず、純粋にプロンプトから動作します。
- ⚠️ **Custom** プリセットは `custom_system_prompt` に実際のシステムプロンプトを指定する必要があります。空欄のままではエラーになります。
- 💡 **style_tag** はプリセットが行う処理の上に、特定のビジュアルスタイルを強制的に適用します。

ko.text:
## LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ 선택한 모델을 첫 실행 때 자동으로 다운로드하므로 몇 분 걸립니다.
- 모델 선택기에는 이미 받은 옵션과 받을 수 있는 다운로드가 함께 표시됩니다.

**LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝**:
- 대충 쓴 `prompt_text`를 입력하고 프리셋을 고르세요.

- 텍스트 전용이라 이미지나 비디오 입력이 필요 없습니다. 프롬프트만으로 바로 동작합니다.
- ⚠️ **Custom** 프리셋은 `custom_system_prompt`에 실제 system prompt가 필요합니다. 비워 두면 오류가 납니다.
- 💡 **style_tag**는 프리셋이 이미 하는 일 위에 재작성을 특정 비주얼 스타일로 고정합니다.

nodes.title: LC Lighting Control V2 🔦

en.text:
# LC Lighting Control V2 🔦 

---

Relight any image from a **normal map** + **depth map** (optional **subject mask**). Real cast shadows, hard or soft.

✋ **Start here**
- Pick a **preset**, then drag the light on the **stage**. That is 90% of it.
- Change any value and the preset flips to **custom** (nothing is lost, it just gets a new label).
- The old **LC Lighting Control 🔦** is a separate node and still works.

### The stage
- **Drag** = X / Y (where the light is. +X is right, +Y is up)
- **Shift+drag** or **wheel** = Z (0 = side on, 1 = head on)
- White = light 1, red = light 2. Pick a gel color and the handle takes it on.
- The blue arrow shows where the shadow falls.
- 💡 A light near the middle is head-on, so it throws no sideways shadow. Move it out to see one.

### Presets
- **Soft window** (left / right), **Rembrandt**, **Split** (hard side), **Top light**, **Under light**, **Rim / back light**, **Golden hour**, **Campfire**, **Cyberpunk**, **Key + fill**, **Flat front**
- A preset sets everything, fine controls included. Start there, then nudge.

### Each light
- **type**: spot = a beam, sun = even light over the whole frame
- **brightness**: 1.2 to 1.5 is a natural key light
- **spread**: how wide the spot beam is (sun ignores it)
- **warmth**: cool blue to warm orange. Golden hour lives around 0.7
- **color** + **color_amount**: an optional colored gel (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, magenta). 0.3 to 0.6 looks natural
  - *note:* the color only shows where that light reaches, so 
  - 💡 dial the light size way down when using colors so it doesn't saturate the entire image
  - shadows fall back to the neutral fill
- **enable_light_2**: a second light. Fill or rim, keep it dim

### The look
- **blend**: relit vs original. 0.7 to 0.9 looks best
- **light_wrap**: how gradually light rolls into shade on the face. 0 = hard lamp
- **fill**: the floor the shadows never drop below. 0 = pitch black, 0.2 = natural

### Shadows
- **shadows**: soft / hard / off
- **shadow_amount**: how dark
- **shadow_blur**: blurs the edge. Shadow looks cut out? Raise this
- **background_shadow**: 1 = a wall right behind, 0 = a distant background with nothing to catch a shadow
- **self_shadow**: how strongly the subject shadows itself (nose, chin, hair). Needs a mask
- **relief**: how deep the scene is in 3D. More = longer, stronger shadows
- **advanced**: shows the rest (depth falloff, shadow height / length / softness, subject distance, mask dome)
 
### Mask
- Connect one and the subject throws a shadow on the wall behind it.
- **subject_distance**: how far in front of the wall. 0 = flat against it

### Outputs
- **image**: the relit image
- **shadow_mask**: white = lit, black = in shadow
- **light_layer**: the light on its own (the color shows here too)

### Quick fixes

| Problem | Try |
|---------|-----|
| Harsh, cut out | raise **shadow_blur** or **light_wrap**, lower **blend** |
| Muddy, too dark | raise **fill** or **brightness** |
| Flat | lower **fill**, move the light off center, lower **Z** |
| No shadow on the wall | connect the mask, raise **background_shadow** and **subject_distance** |
| Shadow on a far-away room | lower **background_shadow** |


## 💡 Portraits

- start with **Rembrandt** or **Soft window**
- **Warm scenes:** **Golden hour**, or **Campfire** for a low orange glow
- **Neon:** **Cyberpunk** is two colored lights. Swap the colors to taste
- **Two lights:** turn on **enable_light_2**, keep it dim (about 0.5) and cool
- **Room behind the subject?** Set **background_shadow** to 0 to 0.2 so she isn't throwing shadows on a couch ten feet away
- **Spot lights:** don't park one on the border of the stage, it messes up the cone
- ⚠️ Shadows are strong on purpose (that's why there is a **blend**)


---

**"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"**  
_Yoda Auditore, *Assassin's Wars*_

zh.text:
# LC Lighting Control V2 🔦 

---

根据**法线图** + **深度图**（可选**主体蒙版**）为任意图像重新打光。真实的投射阴影，硬阴影或软阴影都行。

✋ **从这里开始**
- 选一个**预设**，然后在**舞台**上拖动灯光。这就是 90% 的操作。
- 改动任何数值，预设就会切换为 **custom**（什么都不会丢失，只是换了个新标签）。
- 旧的 **LC Lighting Control 🔦** 是另一个独立节点，仍然可以用。

### 舞台
- **拖动** = X / Y（灯光的位置。+X 向右，+Y 向上）
- **Shift+拖动** 或 **滚轮** = Z（0 = 侧面照射，1 = 正面照射）
- 白色 = 灯光 1，红色 = 灯光 2。选择滤光片颜色后，手柄会变成那个颜色。
- 蓝色箭头显示阴影落下的方向。
- 💡 靠近中间的灯是正面光，所以不会投出侧向阴影。把它移出去才能看到阴影。

### 预设
- **Soft window**（左 / 右）、**Rembrandt**、**Split**（硬侧光）、**Top light**、**Under light**、**Rim / back light**、**Golden hour**、**Campfire**、**Cyberpunk**、**Key + fill**、**Flat front**
- 预设会设定一切，包括精细控制项。从预设开始，再微调。

### 每盏灯
- **type**：spot = 一束光，sun = 照亮整个画面的均匀光
- **brightness**：1.2 到 1.5 是自然的主光
- **spread**：聚光束有多宽（sun 会忽略它）
- **warmth**：从冷蓝到暖橙。Golden hour 大约在 0.7
- **color** + **color_amount**：可选的彩色滤光片（red、orange、yellow、green、cyan、blue、purple、magenta）。0.3 到 0.6 看起来比较自然
  - *注：* 颜色只会出现在那盏灯照到的地方，所以 
  - 💡 用颜色时把灯的大小调得很小，免得整张图过饱和
  - 阴影会退回到中性的补光
- **enable_light_2**：第二盏灯。用作补光或轮廓光，保持暗一点

### 效果
- **blend**：重新打光与原图的混合。0.7 到 0.9 看起来最好
- **light_wrap**：脸上光线渐变进入阴影的柔和程度。0 = 硬灯
- **fill**：阴影永远不会低于的底线。0 = 漆黑，0.2 = 自然

### 阴影
- **shadows**：soft / hard / off
- **shadow_amount**：多深
- **shadow_blur**：模糊边缘。阴影看起来像剪出来的？调高这个
- **background_shadow**：1 = 身后紧贴一面墙，0 = 背景很远，没有东西能接住阴影
- **self_shadow**：主体对自己投射阴影的强度（鼻子、下巴、头发）。需要蒙版
- **relief**：场景的 3D 深度有多大。越大 = 阴影越长越强
- **advanced**：显示其余选项（深度衰减、阴影高度 / 长度 / 柔和度、主体距离、蒙版穹顶）
 
### 蒙版
- 接入一个，主体就会在身后的墙上投下阴影。
- **subject_distance**：主体在墙前多远。0 = 紧贴墙面

### 输出
- **image**：重新打光后的图像
- **shadow_mask**：白色 = 受光，黑色 = 处于阴影中
- **light_layer**：单独的光照层（颜色也会在这里显示）

### 快速修复

| 问题 | 试试 |
|---------|-----|
| 生硬、像剪出来的 | 调高 **shadow_blur** 或 **light_wrap**，调低 **blend** |
| 浑浊、太暗 | 调高 **fill** 或 **brightness** |
| 平淡 | 调低 **fill**，把灯移离中心，调低 **Z** |
| 墙上没有阴影 | 接入蒙版，调高 **background_shadow** 和 **subject_distance** |
| 阴影落在很远的房间里 | 调低 **background_shadow** |


## 💡 人像

- 从 **Rembrandt** 或 **Soft window** 开始
- **暖色场景：** **Golden hour**，或用 **Campfire** 得到低调的橙色光晕
- **霓虹：** **Cyberpunk** 是两盏彩色灯。颜色按口味替换
- **两盏灯：** 开启 **enable_light_2**，保持较暗（约 0.5）并偏冷
- **主体身后有房间？** 把 **background_shadow** 设为 0 到 0.2，这样她就不会在十英尺外的沙发上投阴影
- **聚光灯：** 不要把灯停在舞台边界上，会弄乱光锥
- ⚠️ 阴影故意做得很强（所以才有 **blend**）


---

**"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"**  
_Yoda Auditore, *Assassin's Wars*_

ja.text:
# LC Lighting Control V2 🔦 

---

**ノーマルマップ** + **深度マップ**（任意で**被写体マスク**）から、どんな画像もリライトします。本物のキャストシャドウを、ハードでもソフトでも。

✋ **まずはここから**
- **プリセット**を選んで、**ステージ**上のライトをドラッグします。これで9割は完成です。
- どれか1つでも値を変えると、プリセットは**custom**に切り替わります（何も失われません。ラベルが変わるだけです）。
- 旧版の **LC Lighting Control 🔦** は別のノードで、今も動きます。

### ステージ
- **ドラッグ**＝X / Y（ライトの位置。+Xは右、+Yは上）
- **Shift+ドラッグ**または**ホイール**＝Z（0＝真横から、1＝正面から）
- 白＝ライト1、赤＝ライト2。ジェルの色を選ぶと、ハンドルもその色になります。
- 青い矢印は、影が落ちる方向を示します。
- 💡 中央付近のライトは正面からなので、横向きの影は落ちません。外側に動かすと影が見えます。

### プリセット
- **Soft window**（左 / 右）、**Rembrandt**、**Split**（ハードなサイド光）、**Top light**、**Under light**、**Rim / back light**、**Golden hour**、**Campfire**、**Cyberpunk**、**Key + fill**、**Flat front**
- プリセットは、細かいコントロールも含めてすべてを設定します。まずそこから始めて、微調整しましょう。

### 各ライト
- **type**: spot＝ビーム、sun＝フレーム全体を均一に照らす光
- **brightness**: 自然なキーライトは1.2〜1.5
- **spread**: スポットビームの広さ（sunでは無視されます）
- **warmth**: 冷たい青から暖かいオレンジまで。ゴールデンアワーは0.7あたり
- **color** + **color_amount**: 任意のカラージェル（red、orange、yellow、green、cyan、blue、purple、magenta）。自然に見えるのは0.3〜0.6
  - *注意：* 色はそのライトが届く場所にしか出ないので、
  - 💡 色を使うときはライトのサイズをかなり下げて、画像全体が飽和しないようにしましょう
  - 影はニュートラルなフィルに戻ります
- **enable_light_2**: 2つ目のライト。フィルかリムとして、控えめに

### ルック
- **blend**: リライト後と元画像の比率。0.7〜0.9が一番きれいです
- **light_wrap**: 顔の上で、光が影へ移り変わる緩やかさ。0＝ハードなランプ
- **fill**: 影がそれ以上は暗くならない下限。0＝真っ暗、0.2＝自然

### 影
- **shadows**: soft / hard / off
- **shadow_amount**: どれだけ暗くするか
- **shadow_blur**: 影の縁をぼかします。影が切り抜いたように見えるなら、これを上げます
- **background_shadow**: 1＝すぐ後ろに壁がある、0＝影を受けるものがない遠い背景
- **self_shadow**: 被写体が自分自身に落とす影の強さ（鼻、あご、髪）。マスクが必要です
- **relief**: シーンの3Dとしての深さ。大きいほど、影が長く強くなります
- **advanced**: 残りを表示します（depth falloff、shadow height / length / softness、subject distance、mask dome）
 
### マスク
- つなぐと、被写体が背後の壁に影を落とします。
- **subject_distance**: 壁からどれだけ手前にいるか。0＝壁にぴったり

### 出力
- **image**: リライト後の画像
- **shadow_mask**: 白＝照らされている、黒＝影の中
- **light_layer**: 光だけを取り出したもの（色もここに出ます）

### 手早い対処法

| 問題 | 対処 |
|---------|-----|
| きつい、切り抜いたように見える | **shadow_blur** か **light_wrap** を上げる、**blend** を下げる |
| 濁っている、暗すぎる | **fill** か **brightness** を上げる |
| のっぺりしている | **fill** を下げる、ライトを中央から外す、**Z** を下げる |
| 壁に影が出ない | マスクをつなぐ、**background_shadow** と **subject_distance** を上げる |
| 遠くにある部屋に影が出る | **background_shadow** を下げる |


## 💡 ポートレート

- **Rembrandt** か **Soft window** から始めます
- **暖かいシーン：** **Golden hour**、または低いオレンジの光なら **Campfire**
- **ネオン：** **Cyberpunk** は色付きのライト2灯です。好みで色を入れ替えてください
- **2灯使い：** **enable_light_2** をオンにして、控えめ（0.5くらい）に、冷たい色で
- **被写体の後ろに部屋がある？** **background_shadow** を0〜0.2にして、3メートル先のソファに彼女の影が落ちないようにします
- **スポットライト：** ステージの境界線上には置かないでください。コーンが崩れます
- ⚠️ 影はわざと強めに出ます（だから **blend** があります）


---

**"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"**  
_Yoda Auditore, *Assassin's Wars*_

ko.text:
# LC Lighting Control V2 🔦 

---

**normal map** + **depth map**(선택 사항인 **피사체 마스크**)으로 어떤 이미지든 리라이트합니다. 하드 또는 소프트, 진짜 캐스트 섀도.

✋ **여기서 시작**
- **프리셋**을 고르고 **스테이지**에서 라이트를 드래그하세요. 이게 90%입니다.
- 값을 하나라도 바꾸면 프리셋이 **custom**으로 바뀝니다 (아무것도 잃지 않고, 이름표만 새로 붙습니다).
- 예전 **LC Lighting Control 🔦**은 별개의 노드이고 여전히 작동합니다.

### 스테이지
- **드래그** = X / Y (라이트 위치. +X는 오른쪽, +Y는 위)
- **Shift+드래그** 또는 **휠** = Z (0 = 측면, 1 = 정면)
- 흰색 = 라이트 1, 빨간색 = 라이트 2. 젤 색을 고르면 핸들도 그 색이 됩니다.
- 파란 화살표는 그림자가 지는 방향을 보여줍니다.
- 💡 가운데 근처의 라이트는 정면이라 옆으로 그림자가 지지 않습니다. 바깥으로 옮겨야 보입니다.

### 프리셋
- **Soft window** (왼쪽 / 오른쪽), **Rembrandt**, **Split** (하드 측면), **Top light**, **Under light**, **Rim / back light**, **Golden hour**, **Campfire**, **Cyberpunk**, **Key + fill**, **Flat front**
- 프리셋은 세부 컨트롤까지 전부 설정합니다. 거기서 시작해서 살짝 손보세요.

### 각 라이트
- **type**: spot = 빔, sun = 프레임 전체에 고른 빛
- **brightness**: 1.2~1.5가 자연스러운 키 라이트
- **spread**: 스폿 빔이 얼마나 넓은지 (sun은 무시)
- **warmth**: 차가운 파랑에서 따뜻한 주황까지. Golden hour는 0.7 근처
- **color** + **color_amount**: 선택 사항인 컬러 젤 (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, magenta). 0.3~0.6이 자연스럽습니다
  - *참고:* 색은 그 라이트가 닿는 곳에만 나타나므로 
  - 💡 색을 쓸 때는 이미지 전체가 포화되지 않도록 라이트 size를 많이 낮추세요
  - 그림자는 중립 fill로 돌아갑니다
- **enable_light_2**: 두 번째 라이트. 필이나 림으로, 어둡게 두세요

### 룩
- **blend**: 리라이트 대 원본. 0.7~0.9가 가장 좋아 보입니다
- **light_wrap**: 얼굴에서 빛이 그늘로 얼마나 서서히 넘어가는지. 0 = 하드 램프
- **fill**: 그림자가 절대 내려가지 않는 하한선. 0 = 칠흑, 0.2 = 자연스러움

### 그림자
- **shadows**: soft / hard / off
- **shadow_amount**: 얼마나 어둡게
- **shadow_blur**: 가장자리를 블러. 그림자가 오려 붙인 것 같나요? 이걸 올리세요
- **background_shadow**: 1 = 바로 뒤에 벽, 0 = 그림자를 받을 게 없는 먼 배경
- **self_shadow**: 피사체가 자기 자신에게 지는 그림자(코, 턱, 머리카락)의 강도. 마스크 필요
- **relief**: 장면의 3D 깊이. 많을수록 그림자가 더 길고 강해집니다
- **advanced**: 나머지를 표시 (depth 감쇠, 그림자 높이 / 길이 / 부드러움, 피사체 거리, 마스크 돔)
 
### 마스크
- 연결하면 피사체가 뒤쪽 벽에 그림자를 드리웁니다.
- **subject_distance**: 벽에서 앞으로 얼마나 떨어져 있는지. 0 = 벽에 딱 붙음

### 출력
- **image**: 리라이트된 이미지
- **shadow_mask**: 흰색 = 빛 받음, 검정 = 그림자 속
- **light_layer**: 빛만 따로 (색도 여기 표시됩니다)

### 빠른 해결

| 문제 | 시도 |
|---------|-----|
| 거칠고 오려 붙인 느낌 | **shadow_blur**나 **light_wrap**을 올리고, **blend**를 낮추기 |
| 탁하고 너무 어두움 | **fill**이나 **brightness** 올리기 |
| 평평함 | **fill**을 낮추고, 라이트를 중심에서 옮기고, **Z**를 낮추기 |
| 벽에 그림자가 없음 | 마스크를 연결하고 **background_shadow**와 **subject_distance**를 올리기 |
| 멀리 있는 방에 그림자가 생김 | **background_shadow**를 낮추기 |


## 💡 인물 사진

- **Rembrandt**나 **Soft window**로 시작
- **따뜻한 장면:** **Golden hour**, 또는 낮은 주황빛 광채가 필요하면 **Campfire**
- **네온:** **Cyberpunk**는 컬러 라이트 두 개입니다. 색은 취향대로 바꾸세요
- **라이트 두 개:** **enable_light_2**를 켜고, 어둡게(약 0.5), 차갑게 두세요
- **피사체 뒤에 방이 있나요?** 3m 뒤 소파에 그림자가 지지 않도록 **background_shadow**를 0~0.2로 설정하세요
- **스폿 라이트:** 스테이지 경계에 놓지 마세요, 원뿔이 망가집니다
- ⚠️ 그림자는 일부러 강합니다 (그래서 **blend**가 있는 겁니다)


---

**"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"**  
_Yoda Auditore, *Assassin's Wars*_

widgets_values:
# LC Lighting Control V2 🔦 

---

Relight any image from a **normal map** + **depth map** (optional **subject mask**). Real cast shadows, hard or soft.

✋ **Start here**
- Pick a **preset**, then drag the light on the **stage**. That is 90% of it.
- Change any value and the preset flips to **custom** (nothing is lost, it just gets a new label).
- The old **LC Lighting Control 🔦** is a separate node and still works.

### The stage
- **Drag** = X / Y (where the light is. +X is right, +Y is up)
- **Shift+drag** or **wheel** = Z (0 = side on, 1 = head on)
- White = light 1, red = light 2. Pick a gel color and the handle takes it on.
- The blue arrow shows where the shadow falls.
- 💡 A light near the middle is head-on, so it throws no sideways shadow. Move it out to see one.

### Presets
- **Soft window** (left / right), **Rembrandt**, **Split** (hard side), **Top light**, **Under light**, **Rim / back light**, **Golden hour**, **Campfire**, **Cyberpunk**, **Key + fill**, **Flat front**
- A preset sets everything, fine controls included. Start there, then nudge.

### Each light
- **type**: spot = a beam, sun = even light over the whole frame
- **brightness**: 1.2 to 1.5 is a natural key light
- **spread**: how wide the spot beam is (sun ignores it)
- **warmth**: cool blue to warm orange. Golden hour lives around 0.7
- **color** + **color_amount**: an optional colored gel (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, magenta). 0.3 to 0.6 looks natural
  - *note:* the color only shows where that light reaches, so 
  - 💡 dial the light size way down when using colors so it doesn't saturate the entire image
  - shadows fall back to the neutral fill
- **enable_light_2**: a second light. Fill or rim, keep it dim

### The look
- **blend**: relit vs original. 0.7 to 0.9 looks best
- **light_wrap**: how gradually light rolls into shade on the face. 0 = hard lamp
- **fill**: the floor the shadows never drop below. 0 = pitch black, 0.2 = natural

### Shadows
- **shadows**: soft / hard / off
- **shadow_amount**: how dark
- **shadow_blur**: blurs the edge. Shadow looks cut out? Raise this
- **background_shadow**: 1 = a wall right behind, 0 = a distant background with nothing to catch a shadow
- **self_shadow**: how strongly the subject shadows itself (nose, chin, hair). Needs a mask
- **relief**: how deep the scene is in 3D. More = longer, stronger shadows
- **advanced**: shows the rest (depth falloff, shadow height / length / softness, subject distance, mask dome)
 
### Mask
- Connect one and the subject throws a shadow on the wall behind it.
- **subject_distance**: how far in front of the wall. 0 = flat against it

### Outputs
- **image**: the relit image
- **shadow_mask**: white = lit, black = in shadow
- **light_layer**: the light on its own (the color shows here too)

### Quick fixes

| Problem | Try |
|---------|-----|
| Harsh, cut out | raise **shadow_blur** or **light_wrap**, lower **blend** |
| Muddy, too dark | raise **fill** or **brightness** |
| Flat | lower **fill**, move the light off center, lower **Z** |
| No shadow on the wall | connect the mask, raise **background_shadow** and **subject_distance** |
| Shadow on a far-away room | lower **background_shadow** |


## 💡 Portraits

- start with **Rembrandt** or **Soft window**
- **Warm scenes:** **Golden hour**, or **Campfire** for a low orange glow
- **Neon:** **Cyberpunk** is two colored lights. Swap the colors to taste
- **Two lights:** turn on **enable_light_2**, keep it dim (about 0.5) and cool
- **Room behind the subject?** Set **background_shadow** to 0 to 0.2 so she isn't throwing shadows on a couch ten feet away
- **Spot lights:** don't park one on the border of the stage, it messes up the cone
- ⚠️ Shadows are strong on purpose (that's why there is a **blend**)


---

**"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"**  
_Yoda Auditore, *Assassin's Wars*_
