| **LC Notify 🔊** | Plays a chosen sound when the node runs (always, on empty queue, or never). |
| **LC Phone Filters 📱** | 37 phone-app filter presets (1977, Aden, Brooklyn, etc.) with strength and an on-node wipe. |
| **LC Photo Style 📷** | Gives an image a phone-camera look from a style preset, with sliders and a strength blend. |
| **LC Pipe (in/edit)** | Packs values into an LC_PIPE, or merges overrides into an existing pipe. |
| **LC Pipe Combine** | Edits the top pipe with a second pipe: whatever the edit pipe carries overwrites the top one, everything else rides along. |
| **LC Pipe Out** | Expands an LC_PIPE into individual sockets and passes the pipe on. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew. |
| **LC Preview Image 🖼️** | Previews an image and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives. |
| **LC Preview Mask 🎭** | Previews a mask and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives. |
| **LC Prompt List 🗒️** | One prompt per line, sent out as a list: every line runs as its own generation. Blank lines and lines starting with // are left out. Replaces CR Prompt List (same inputs and outputs). |
| **LC Prompt to Conditioning + Zero** | Encodes a prompt into conditioning and also outputs a zeroed copy for the negative. |
| **LC Reference Latent** | Attaches up to eight reference latents to conditioning. Chain more than one and they add up. |
| **LC RTX Super Resolution ⚡** | NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution on pictures or video frames: upscale up to 4x, upscale a clean source, denoise or deblur. Quality LOW to ULTRA, scale or megapixels, strength. Shows an Install RTX support button when nvidia-vfx is missing. |
| **LC Sampler Configure** | Central dual-pass sampler settings: steps, swap point, detailer steps, denoise, CFGs, sampler and scheduler. |
| **LC Sampler Configure (pipe)** | Dual-pass sampler settings with an optional pipe in and a pipe out. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Pipe Out** | Unpacks an LC_PIPE into the sampler configure sockets, plus the latent. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple** | Single-pass sampler settings with one CFG and no step swap. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple (pipe)** | Simple sampler settings that read from and write to an LC_PIPE. |
| **LC Sampler Scheduler ⚙️** | Pick the sampler and scheduler once and wire them to every KSampler, so they all change together. |
| **LC Save Image 💾** | Saves images with workflow metadata, and CivitAI parameters when paired with LC Save Metadata. |
| **LC Save Metadata 🏷️** | Builds the metadata (models, AIR or URL, settings) that LC Save Image writes. |
| **LC Seed Jump 🌱** | Takes a seed and a jump value and outputs the seed plus five successive jumps. |
| **LC Sharpen Pro** | Undoes softness (deconvolution) with texture and clarity, halo control and skin protection (optional skin_mask from LC Skin Master). Presets for photos, line art, anime and illustration. |
| **LC Show Any 🔤** | Shows any value on the node and passes it through with its type unchanged. |
| **LC Show Text 🔤** | Shows a string on the node and passes it on. |
| **LC Sigma Curve** | Draw a custom sigma curve on the node, save it, and reuse it. |
| **LC Sigma Resample** | Resamples a sigma curve to a new step count while keeping its start and end sigma (also registered as LCChangeStepCount). |
| **LC Sigmas (BETA)** | One scheduler for one- and two-pass sampling: sigma curve presets (base, beta, flowmatch, hyperbolic, gaussian, your saved curves) you can bend by dragging the graph, step swap, denoise, continue or renoise on the second pass, and sigma shift. Takes regular and RES4LYF / ClownShark sampler names. |
| **LC Size Pad 📐** | A 2D slider for width x height: drag the frame's corner. Model presets (MiniMax H3, Krea 2, SDXL, LTX, Klein 9B, Wan 2.2) snap to the model's step and stop at its megapixel limit; aspect lock and portrait / landscape flip. |
| **LC Skin Beauty ✨** | Cools, brightens and evens skin in LAB with presets, protecting highlights, with an optional mask. Runs on GPU or CPU. |
| **LC Skin Master ✨ (BETA)** | The whole skin chain in one node on one face-aware skin map: grit, pores, blemishes, lines, freckles, eyes, skin tone and colour, each done once. Presets from a light clean-up to plastic-skin restore, weathered and sun-kissed. Outputs the skin mask for Sharpen Pro. |
| **LC Skin Texture ✨ (BETA)** | Adds real pore texture to skin that came out too smooth, from a real skin photo (only its fine relief, never its colour). Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone. |
| **LC Skin Upscale** | Upscales only the masked skin area with a CNN model and blends it back. Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone. |
| **LC Slider** | A slider on the node face that outputs an int or float. |
| **LC Speed Boost (BETA) 🚀** | About 2x faster sampling (about 1.4x on SDXL / Pony / Illustrious), same quality: the picture starts at half size and grows to full size partway through. Plug it into the high pass sampler. Does not work on MOSS Image. |
| **LC Speed Boost 🚀 KSampler (BETA)** | A KSampler with Speed Boost built in. Same inputs, plus start / end at step so it can chain into another sampler. Takes ClownShark (RES4LYF) samplers. |
| **LC Split Sigma Scheduler** | Splits sigmas between two models for a dual-model SamplerCustomAdvanced. |
| **LC Split Sigmas (Advanced)** | Splits sigma curves at a swap step into a high and a low set. |
| **LC Stop 🛑** | A queue breakpoint you can enable. The play button (or Run) carries on with the same seeds, so everything above the stop comes from the cache. |
| **LC Text Overlay** | Draws text on an image with a draggable position, font size and color. |
| **LC Text Remove 🔪** | Removes up to twenty substrings from a text, in order. |
| **LC Text Replace ✂️** | Runs up to twenty find and replace pairs (optionally regex) on a text. |
| **LC Timer ⏱️** | Times every run and scores the newest one against the 5 before it: faster in green, slower in red. Lists the last 10 runs. Stopped and fully cached runs are left out. |
| **LC Tone Match** | Keeps the reference's broad lighting and color while keeping the image's fine detail, with an optional mask. |
| **LC Vibrance** | Smart saturation (vibrance) with optional plain saturation and skin protection. |
| **LC Vignette** | Darkens or brightens the edges of the image. |
| **LC VRAM Cache Clear** | A pass-through node that clears GPU and model cache when it runs, also on its own branch with nothing after it. |
| **LC Watermark 💧** | Composites a watermark image you position by dragging, with live size and opacity. Transparent PNGs keep their transparency through watermark_mask. |
| **LC Weighted Prompt ⚖️** | A prompt box with a weight per word: click a word, move the slider (green above 1 with its number, red below, under 0 taken out). Type in the box or wire a prompt in and edit it there; block (on change, always, never) decides which one is used. Krea 2 (plain, Image Reference Edit, Identity Edit, ControlNet), MOSS Image, Anima and CLIP models. |
| **LC Widget To String** | Reads a widget on another node as a string. |
| **LC ✂️ Duplicate Tags 🏷️** | Removes repeated tags so none gets double weight (long_hair = (long hair:1.2)). Optional second prompt to merge two and clean them together. |
| **LC 🚦** | A light for a boolean: one color for true, one for false (or none). Colors behind the gear. |
| **Legend Effects 🪄** | In homage to Legendaer: VHS TV, Pixelation, Digital Glitch, Night Vision, Blueprint, Frosted Glass, Gameboy, Edge-Preserving Blur, Morphology and Quantize on one node. Pick a look and only its settings show; strength and the on-node wipe compare. |
| **Prompt** | A prompt text box (was LC Positive). The Vision Assistant swaps it in for other packs' text boxes, or LC Negative when the box feeds a negative. |
| **Prompt to Conditioning** | Encodes a text prompt into CLIP conditioning. |
| **🌱LC Seed** | A utility seed with a mode that also works when you queue only this node. |
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | Picks a 4 to 6 color palette from a preset or from an image, for use in prompts. |
| **🎲LC Wildcard** | Picks a random line from a wildcard text file. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | Resizes an image and/or mask to a target size and outputs image, mask, size, empty latent and batch. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)** | Does the same as the Aspect Ratio Simplifier and adds a pipe output for Get/Set. |
| **📝 LC Save Text** | Writes a text string to a file in the output folder. |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | Sets camera framing and depth of field for a prompt from distance and angle presets. |
| **🗒️LC Lighting** | Sets lighting style and direction for a prompt from presets plus your own notes. |
| **🗒️LC Scene Builder** | Builds a scene description from scene presets and objects. |
| **🗒️LC Style Selector** | Picks a style preset (and quality level) for a prompt and adds your own notes. |
| **🗒️LC Subject** | Describes the subject of a prompt with freeform text plus pose, action, outfit and placement options. |
| **🗒️LC Subject Array** | Combines several subject outputs into one line. |
| **🧩LC Prompt Assembler** | Assembles the prompt builder pieces (subject, camera, lighting, style, scene) into one prompt or JSON. |

en.text:
## LC Relay VSR Upscale 🧩

**What is it?**

- Relay VSR in one node. The model, VAE and sampler are built in.
- Use 2x or 4x for images 🖼️ 
- 2x or 4x for video 🎞️ (2x on smaller machines)
- A fraction of the time VOSR2 or SEEDVR2 takes, and higher quality.
- ✋ **The first run downloads the models:** 5.2 GB per model, plus a 128 MB VAE, into `models/diffusion_models` and `models/vae`. A toast tells you it started. Press Stop to cancel. Already have them? They are found wherever they are.

- 適用於影片 🎞️ 的 2x 或 4x 上升解析度（較小機型建議使用 2x）
- 比 VOSR2 或 SEEDVR2 快許多，且畫質更高。

ko.title: Prepare Prompt & Controlnet
ko.text: 프롬프트에서 원치 않는 태그를 정리합니다. 비전으로 강화하세요. 원하면 depth control LoRA를 적용하세요.

3618|max_tokens.text: 비전 모델의 토큰 수를 제한해서 과처리를 막습니다.

steps.title: Encoders
steps.text: The Encoders are what takes your prompt or reference and turns it into conditioning for the Sampler.

settings.why: Uses only the prompt to generate the image.
Uses the images you choose as references with your prompt.
You can also enable 🥅 here

zh.title: Encoders
zh.text: Encoders 负责把你的提示词或参考图转换成给 Sampler 用的 conditioning。

3496|Enable 2.text: 把你选的图片作为参考，配合你的提示词使用。

ja.title: Encoders
ja.text: エンコーダーは、あなたのプロンプトや参照を、サンプラー用のコンディショニングに変換するものです。

3496|Enable 1.text: プロンプトだけで画像を生成します。

3496|Enable 2.text: 選んだ画像を、プロンプトと一緒に参照として使います。

3506|Enable 1.text: ここで 🥅 も有効にできます

ko.title: Encoders
ko.text: Encoder는 프롬프트나 레퍼런스를 Sampler가 쓸 conditioning으로 바꿔주는 부분입니다.

3496|Enable 2.text: 고른 이미지를 프롬프트와 함께 레퍼런스로 사용합니다.

steps.title: User Settings/ Prompts/ LoRA
steps.text: Pick your base model and sampler. Set denoise to 0.95 for strong detail. Adjust CFG for balance.

Total steps for generation
this is the step that the second sampler kicks in . It should typically be around 75% of the total generation

These switches are here for your convenience.
Type your prompt here

zh.title: 用户设置 / 提示词 / LoRA
zh.text: 选择基础模型和 sampler。想要强细节就把 denoise 设为 0.95。调整 CFG 来平衡。

3857|base_model.text: 选择用于生成图片的主模型。

3014|step_swap.text: 第二个采样器接手的那一步。通常在总生成步数的 75% 左右

3014|denoise.text: 主要用于 I2I。日常用 0.95 不错。I2I 用 0.7 或 0.85

3054|Enable 1.text: 这些开关是为了方便你而放的。

ja.title: User Settings/ Prompts/ LoRA
ja.text: ベースモデルと sampler を選びます。強いディテールには denoise を 0.95 に。CFG でバランスを調整します。

3857|base_model.text: 画像生成のメインモデルを選びます。

3014|step_swap.text: 2番目のサンプラーが引き継ぐステップです。通常は全体の75%くらいにします。

3054|Enable 1.text: このスイッチは、あなたの便宜のためにここにあります。

2909|positive.text: ここにプロンプトを入力

ko.title: User Settings/ Prompts/ LoRA
ko.text: base model과 sampler를 고르세요. 디테일을 강하게 하려면 denoise를 0.95로. 균형은 CFG로 조절하세요.

3857|base_model.text: 이미지 생성에 쓸 메인 모델을 고릅니다.

3014|step_swap.text: 두 번째 샘플러가 넘겨받는 step입니다. 보통 전체 생성의 75% 정도가 좋습니다.

steps.title: LC Weighted Prompt ⚖️
steps.text:
Remember weighting a word back in the SDXL days when the prompt got stubborn? Yeah, me too 🤔

Click a word to highlight it (shift-click a second one for a phrase), drag the slider to set its weight, then hit ▶️ Run.

settings.why: on change: your edits hold until a new prompt comes in. always: a new prompt stops the run here so you can weight it first, then Run carries on with the same seeds.
Scales every weight at once. Lower it if a weighted word starts to break the picture up.

zh.title: LC Weighted Prompt ⚖️
zh.text:
还记得 SDXL 时代提示词不听话时给词加权重吗？我也记得 🤔

点一个词把它高亮（按住 Shift 再点第二个词可选短语），拖动滑块设置权重，然后点 ▶️ Run。

4114|block.text: on change：在新提示词进来之前，你的修改都会保留。always：新提示词进来时会在这里停下，让你先加权重，然后 Run 用同样的 seed 继续。

4114|strength.text: 一次缩放所有权重。如果加了权重的词开始把画面弄乱，就调低它。

ja.title: LC Weighted Prompt ⚖️
ja.text:
SDXL の頃、プロンプトが言うことを聞かないときに単語に重みを付けていたのを覚えていますか？私もです 🤔

単語をクリックしてハイライトし（Shift を押しながら 2 つ目をクリックするとフレーズ）、スライダーで重みを設定して ▶️ Run を押します。

4114|block.text: on change：新しいプロンプトが来るまで編集内容を保持します。always：新しいプロンプトが来るとここで止まるので先に重みを付け、Run で同じ seed のまま続けます。

4114|strength.text: すべての重みをまとめて調整します。重みを付けた単語で絵が崩れ始めたら下げてください。

ko.title: LC Weighted Prompt ⚖️
ko.text:
SDXL 시절, 프롬프트가 말을 안 들을 때 단어에 가중치를 주던 거 기억나세요? 네, 저도요 🤔

단어를 클릭해서 하이라이트하고(Shift를 누른 채 두 번째 단어를 클릭하면 구절), 슬라이더를 드래그해 가중치를 정한 다음 ▶️ Run을 누르세요.

4114|block.text: on change: 새 프롬프트가 들어올 때까지 편집한 내용이 유지됩니다. always: 새 프롬프트가 들어오면 여기서 멈추니 먼저 가중치를 주고, Run을 누르면 같은 seed로 이어갑니다.

4114|strength.text: 모든 가중치를 한 번에 조절합니다. 가중치를 준 단어 때문에 그림이 깨지기 시작하면 낮추세요.

steps.title: Krea Moodboard 📝
steps.text:
I highly suggest going to the website and searching it. This can get overwhelming with over 3,500 options, but the results can be very rewarding. 

Spend a bit of time finding your favorites and save them.

zh.title: Krea Moodboard 📝
zh.text:
我强烈建议去网站上搜一搜。3,500 多个选项可能让人眼花缭乱,但结果可以非常值得。

花点时间找出你的最爱并保存下来。

ja.title: Krea Moodboard 📝
ja.text:
サイトに行って検索してみることを強くおすすめします。3,500以上もあると圧倒されますが、見つかったときの見返りは大きいです。

少し時間をかけてお気に入りを探して、保存しておきましょう。

ko.title: Krea Moodboard 📝
ko.text:
웹사이트에 가서 검색해 보시길 강력 추천합니다. 3,500개가 넘는 옵션이라 정신없을 수 있지만, 결과는 아주 보람 있어요. 

시간을 조금 들여 마음에 드는 걸 찾아서 저장해 두세요.

steps.title: LC LoRA Loader 🎚️
steps.text:
Place your LoRas here.              

1. The strength controls the clip and model              
2. Organize them (move up and down) with the dots on the left side              
3. Need to know the trigger words? Just click on the ℹ️ and it shows you what is available. Click on any trigger word to copy it, then paste it in the prompt box.

zh.title: LC LoRA Loader 🎚️
zh.text:
LoRA 放这里。              

1. strength 同时控制 clip 和 model              
2. 用左边的圆点上下拖动来排序              
3. 想知道触发词?点 ℹ️ 就能看到可用的触发词。点任意触发词即可复制,再粘贴到提示词框里。

ja.title: LC LoRA Loader 🎚️
ja.text:
LoRA はここに置きます。              

1. strength は clip と model の両方に効きます              
2. 左側のドットで並べ替え(上下移動)できます              
3. トリガーワードが知りたい? ℹ️ をクリックすると使えるものが出ます。トリガーワードをクリックするとコピーされるので、プロンプト欄に貼り付けてください。

ko.title: LC LoRA Loader 🎚️
ko.text:
LoRA는 여기에 넣으세요.              

1. strength는 clip과 model 둘 다 조절합니다              
2. 왼쪽의 점으로 위아래로 옮겨 정리하세요              
3. 트리거 워드가 필요하면 ℹ️를 누르세요. 쓸 수 있는 목록이 나옵니다. 트리거 워드를 클릭하면 복사되니 프롬프트 박스에 붙여 넣으면 돼요.

settings.why: Automatically adjusts speed for faster processing.
Uses Res4Lyf samplers. Note: this only applies to generation, not detailing
most frequently used settings are Base, Beta, and Gaussian
.25- .50 for detail. You really do not need to mess with the other settings
This stops the generation here. Very useful for low VRAM or making tweaks before using the rest of the workflow

zh.title: 🧠 Brains
zh.text: 好玩的都在这儿

3981|auto.text: 自动调整速度,加快处理。

2612|sampler_name.text: 使用 Res4Lyf sampler。注意：只对生成有效，对 detailing 无效

3927|sigma_curve_presets.text: 最常用的设置是 Base、Beta 和 Gaussian

3907|amount.text: 要细节就用 .25- .50。其他设置真的不用去动

3109|enable.text: 到这里就停止生成。对低 VRAM 或者想在用后面部分之前先做调整非常有用

ja.title: 🧠 Brains
ja.text: 楽しいことが全部ここで起こります

3981|auto.text: 処理を速くするために、速度を自動調整します。

3907|amount.text: ディテールなら .25 から .50。他の設定は本当にいじらなくて大丈夫です。

3109|enable.text: ここで生成を止めます。低VRAMのときや、残りを使う前に調整したいときにとても便利です。

ko.title: 🧠 Brains
ko.text: 재미있는 건 전부 여기서 일어납니다

3981|auto.text: 더 빠른 처리를 위해 속도를 자동으로 조절합니다.

2612|sampler_name.text: Res4Lyf sampler를 씁니다. 참고: 생성에만 적용되고, 디테일링에는 적용되지 않습니다.

3927|sigma_curve_presets.text: 가장 자주 쓰는 설정은 Base, Beta, Gaussian입니다.

3907|amount.text: 디테일은 .25~.50. 다른 설정은 정말 만질 필요 없어요.

3109|enable.text: 여기서 생성을 멈춥니다. VRAM이 적거나, 나머지 워크플로우를 쓰기 전에 손볼 때 아주 유용해요.

steps.title: AnyPaint 🖌️
steps.text:
Enable AnyPaint for post-generation touch-ups.

You can inpaint, outpaint, and rotate your image here

settings.why: Choose between inpaint or outpaint here
Turn this on or off to stop generation here before moving forward
same as above
If you want the same outpaint each time, leave this on. Otherwise it snaps back after every generation
Inpaint needs a prompt describing what you want. Outpaint is optional. You can also choose to use the base prompt for this

zh.title: AnyPaint 🖌️
zh.text:
启用 AnyPaint 做出图后的修补。

你可以在这里对图片做局部重绘、扩图和旋转

3914|value.text: 在这里选择 inpaint 还是 outpaint

3870|keep_frame.text: 如果想每次都得到相同的 outpaint，就保持开启。否则每次生成后都会弹回去

3892|positive.text: Inpaint 需要一个描述你想要内容的提示词。Outpaint 是可选的。你也可以选择使用基础提示词

4089|block.text: 开或关,控制是否在这里停止生成再往下走

ja.title: AnyPaint 🖌️
ja.text:
生成後の手直し用に AnyPaint を有効にします。

ここで画像のインペイント、アウトペイント、回転ができます

3914|value.text: ここでインペイントかアウトペイントを選びます

3870|keep_frame.text: 毎回同じ outpaint にしたいなら、オンのままにしてください。そうしないと、生成のたびに元に戻ります

3892|positive.text: Inpaint には、欲しいものを説明するプロンプトが必要です。Outpaint は任意です。ベースプロンプトをこちらにも使うこともできます

4089|block.text: オン/オフで、ここで生成を止めて先に進めなくできます。

ko.title: AnyPaint 🖌️
ko.text:
생성 후 수정을 위해 AnyPaint를 켜세요.

여기서 이미지를 inpaint, outpaint, 회전할 수 있어요

3870|keep_frame.text: 매번 같은 outpaint를 원하면 켜두세요. 아니면 생성이 끝날 때마다 원래대로 돌아갑니다.

3892|positive.text: Inpaint는 원하는 걸 설명하는 프롬프트가 필요합니다. Outpaint는 선택입니다. 여기에 base prompt를 쓰도록 선택할 수도 있습니다.

4089|block.text: 여기서 생성을 멈추고 싶으면 이걸 켜거나 끄세요.

steps.title: Detailers (Typ.)
steps.text:
These replace older detailers. They are skin aware and protect the work done by the detailer before it.

The prompt "face, eyes, hands" is what the SAM3 model looks for

settings.why: Sets resolution for face detailer to match quality.
Adds facial style LoRA for enhanced realism.
nifty little trick. It matches the color tone of the masked area back with the original image so you do not get that washed out look

zh.title: Detailers（典型）
zh.text:
这些用来取代老的 detailer。它们能识别皮肤，并保护前一个 detailer 的成果。

提示词 "face, eyes, hands" 就是 SAM3 模型要找的东西

4019|value.text: 设置 face detailer 的分辨率以匹配画质。

4020|lora_rows.text: 添加面部风格 LoRA 以增强写实感。

4013|tone_match.text: 一个小妙招。它把遮罩区域的色调匹配回原图,这样就不会出现发灰的感觉。

ja.title: Detailers (Typ.)
ja.text:
これらは古いディテイラーの代わりです。肌を認識し、前のディテイラーの仕事を壊さないようにします。

プロンプトの "face, eyes, hands" が、SAM3 モデルが探すものです

4019|value.text: 顔ディテーラーの解像度を、画質に合わせて設定します。

4020|lora_rows.text: リアリズムを高める顔スタイル LoRA を追加します。

4013|tone_match.text: ちょっとしたコツです。マスクした部分の色味を元の画像に合わせ直すので、色が抜けたような見た目になりません。

ko.title: Detailers (Typ.)
ko.text:
예전 detailer를 대체하는 노드예요. 피부를 인식하고, 앞선 detailer가 해놓은 작업을 보호합니다.

"face, eyes, hands" 프롬프트가 SAM3 모델이 찾는 대상입니다

4019|value.text: 얼굴 디테일러의 해상도를 품질에 맞게 설정합니다.

4020|lora_rows.text: 리얼리즘을 높여주는 얼굴 스타일 LoRA를 추가합니다.

4013|tone_match.text: 깔끔한 작은 꼼수예요. 마스크 영역의 색조를 원본 이미지에 맞춰서 색이 바랜 느낌이 나지 않게 합니다.

steps.title: VOSR2 Upscale
steps.text:
An upscaler built for speed and low VRAM, with the highest quality possible.

It uses a dedicated upscale model (VOSR 2.0) that sharpens and adds fine detail without redrawing the picture.

💡it is hooked up to the  detailers and passes along what the detailers already fixed, so LC Skin Upscale and LC Skin Texture don't turn skin pores into freckles or craters.

zh.title: VOSR2 Upscale
zh.text:
一个追求速度、低 VRAM、同时画质尽可能高的放大器。

它用专用放大模型(VOSR 2.0),在不重绘画面的前提下锐化并补充细节。

💡它接在 detailers 后面,会沿用 detailers 已经修好的部分,所以 LC Skin Upscale 和 LC Skin Texture 不会把毛孔变成雀斑或坑洞。

ja.title: VOSR2 Upscale
ja.text:
速度と低VRAMを重視しつつ、最高クオリティを狙ったアップスケーラーです。

専用のアップスケールモデル(VOSR 2.0)を使い、絵を描き直さずにシャープにして細部を足します。

💡ディテーラーの後ろにつながっていて、ディテーラーがすでに直した部分を引き継ぎます。だから LC Skin Upscale や LC Skin Texture が毛穴をそばかすやクレーターにしてしまうことはありません。

ko.title: VOSR2 Upscale
ko.text:
속도와 낮은 VRAM에 맞춘, 최고 품질의 업스케일러입니다.

전용 업스케일 모델(VOSR 2.0)을 써서 그림을 다시 그리지 않고 선명하게 만들고 디테일을 더해요.

💡디테일러 뒤에 연결돼 있어서 디테일러가 이미 고쳐 놓은 부분을 그대로 넘겨받아요. 그래서 LC Skin Upscale과 LC Skin Texture가 피부 모공을 주근깨나 크레이터로 만들지 않습니다.

steps.title: Apply Skin Realism
steps.text:
Your whole skin chain in one node: grit, pores, blemishes, lines, freckles and skin tone.

💡 LC Person Mask is optional. Use it when you want all the skin and none of the clothes.

settings.why: Natural for every day, Soft Beauty for makeup, Editorial Detail for close-ups. Weathered for character (my favorite in most cases).
1 = as it is. Keep it at 1 or more with pigmentation, or the freckles look painted on.
Below 0 softens, above 0 deepens the lines already there.

zh.title: 皮肤真实感
zh.text:
整条皮肤处理链合成一个节点：颗粒、毛孔、瑕疵、纹路、雀斑和肤色。

💡 LC Person Mask 是可选的。想要所有皮肤、不碰衣服时再用它。

4096|preset.text: 日常用 Natural，化妆用 Soft Beauty，特写用 Editorial Detail。想要人物感就用 Weathered（大多数情况下我的最爱）。

4096|pores.text: 1 = 保持原样。和 pigmentation 一起用时保持 1 或以上，不然雀斑看起来像画上去的。

4096|wrinkles.text: 低于 0 会柔化，高于 0 会加深已有的纹路。

ja.title: 肌のリアリズム
ja.text:
肌の処理をまとめて 1 つのノードで：ざらつき、毛穴、シミ、しわ、そばかす、肌のトーン。

💡 LC Person Mask は任意です。服を避けて肌全体を対象にしたいときに使います。

4096|preset.text: 普段は Natural、メイクには Soft Beauty、クローズアップには Editorial Detail。キャラクター感なら Weathered（たいていの場合いちばんのお気に入り）。

4096|pores.text: 1 = そのまま。pigmentation と一緒に使うときは 1 以上に。そうしないとそばかすが描いたように見えます。

4096|wrinkles.text: 0 未満で柔らかく、0 より上で今あるしわを深くします。

ko.title: 피부 리얼리즘
ko.text:
피부 처리 체인 전체를 노드 하나로: 거칠기, 모공, 잡티, 주름, 주근깨, 피부 톤.

💡 LC Person Mask는 선택 사항입니다. 옷은 빼고 피부 전체만 잡고 싶을 때 쓰세요.

4096|preset.text: 평소에는 Natural, 메이크업에는 Soft Beauty, 클로즈업에는 Editorial Detail. 캐릭터 느낌을 원하면 Weathered (대부분의 경우 제 최애).

4096|pores.text: 1 = 그대로. pigmentation과 함께 쓸 때는 1 이상으로 두세요. 안 그러면 주근깨가 그려 넣은 것처럼 보입니다.

4096|wrinkles.text: 0보다 낮으면 부드러워지고, 0보다 높으면 이미 있는 주름이 깊어집니다.

steps.title: Control Lighting & Depth
steps.text: Set Rembrandt lighting preset. Use depth map for shadows. Apply normal map for surface detail.

settings.why: Defines lighting style for cinematic look.
Reverses depth map for proper shadow direction.

zh.title: 控制光线和景深
zh.text: 设置 Rembrandt lighting 预设。用 depth map 做阴影。用 normal map 增加表面细节。

3698|preset.text: 定义电影感的光线风格。

3799|invert.text: 反转 depth map，让阴影方向正确。

ja.title: ライティングと深度のコントロール
ja.text: Rembrandt lighting プリセットを設定します。影には depth map を使います。表面のディテールには normal map を適用します。

3698|preset.text: シネマティックな見た目のためのライティングスタイルを決めます。

3799|invert.text: 影の向きを正しくするため、深度マップを反転します。

ko.title: 조명 & 깊이 제어
ko.text: Rembrandt lighting preset을 설정하세요. 그림자에는 depth map을, 표면 디테일에는 normal map을 쓰세요.

3698|preset.text: 시네마틱한 룩을 위한 조명 스타일을 정합니다.

3799|invert.text: 올바른 그림자 방향을 위해 depth map을 뒤집습니다.

steps.title: Sharpen & Add Depth Effects
steps.text: Apply sharpening for clarity. Add natural depth haze. Crop if needed for composition.

settings.why: Controls sharpness of portrait edges.
Adds atmospheric depth for realism.

zh.title: 锐化与景深效果
zh.text: 加锐化让画面更清晰。加自然的景深雾感。需要的话裁剪以优化构图。

3800|haze.text: 增加大气纵深感，让画面更真实。

ja.title: Sharpen & Add Depth Effects
ja.text: シャープをかけて明瞭に。自然な奥行きのヘイズを足す。構図に必要ならクロップ。

3645|clarity.text: ポートレートのエッジのシャープさを調整します。

3800|haze.text: 大気の奥行きを足して、リアルにします。

ko.title: Sharpen & Add Depth Effects
ko.text: 선명도를 위해 샤프닝을 적용하세요. 자연스러운 depth haze를 더하세요. 구도에 필요하면 크롭하세요.

3800|haze.text: 사실감을 위해 대기감 있는 깊이를 더합니다.

steps.title: Add Film & Camera Effects
steps.text: Apply film grain and bloom. Use Kodak Ektachrome for color. Add vignette for focus.

settings.why: Use for Anime and graphics. Not necessarily for realism.
Use with Depth FX 🌫️
Cool feature to get realistic warping that you get from a true camera lens

zh.title: 添加胶片和相机效果
zh.text: 添加胶片颗粒和 bloom。颜色用 Kodak Ektachrome。加上 vignette 聚焦视线。

3643|vibrance.text: 用于动漫和图形。不一定适合写实。

3634|look.text: 配合 Depth FX 🌫️ 使用

3636|lens.text: 很酷的功能,能得到真实镜头才有的那种畸变效果

ja.title: Film & Camera エフェクトを追加
ja.text: フィルムグレインとブルームを適用。色には Kodak Ektachrome を使います。ビネットを足すとフォーカスが引き立ちます。

3643|vibrance.text: アニメやグラフィック向け。リアル系には必ずしも向きません。

3634|look.text: Depth FX 🌫️ と一緒に使います

3636|lens.text: 本物のカメラレンズで出る、リアルな歪みを再現する便利機能です。

ko.title: 필름 & 카메라 이펙트 추가
ko.text: 필름 그레인과 bloom을 적용하세요. 색감은 Kodak Ektachrome를 쓰세요. 초점을 위해 vignette를 더하세요.

3636|lens.text: 실제 카메라 렌즈에서 나오는 진짜 같은 왜곡을 주는 멋진 기능이에요.

steps.title: Final Filters & Watermark
steps.text: Add film grain and watermark. Apply LUT for color tone. Use natural look for final polish.

settings.why: Adjusts LUT intensity for color grading.
Keep low
This is nifty. three settings. Sensor mimics the grain from a phone camera🤔
The holy grail of realism. Pulls all of the "AI" out of an image

zh.title: 最终滤镜与水印
zh.text: 添加胶片颗粒和水印。用 LUT 调色调。最后用 natural look 收尾。

3624|strength.text: 调整调色用的 LUT 强度。

3629|response.text: 这个很妙。三个设置。Sensor 模仿手机相机的颗粒🤔

3995|strength.text: 写实的圣杯。把图像里所有的 "AI 味" 都拔掉

ja.title: Final Filters & Watermark
ja.text: フィルムグレインとウォーターマークを追加。LUT で色調を付けます。仕上げには natural look を使います。

3624|strength.text: カラーグレーディング用の LUT 強度を調整します。

3629|response.text: これはなかなかいいですよ。設定は3つ。Sensor はスマホカメラのグレインを真似ます🤔

3995|strength.text: リアリズムの聖杯。画像から「AIっぽさ」を全部抜き取ります

ko.title: Final Filters & Watermark
ko.text: 필름 그레인과 워터마크를 추가하세요. LUT로 색조를 적용하고, 마지막 마무리는 natural look으로 하세요.

3629|response.text: 이거 꽤 쓸만해요. 설정은 세 가지. Sensor는 폰 카메라의 그레인을 흉내 내요🤔

3995|strength.text: 사실감의 성배. 이미지에서 "AI" 티를 전부 뽑아냅니다

steps.title: Save Draft & Metadata
steps.text: Save draft to 'Drafts' folder. Embed workflow and CivitAI metadata for tracking.

settings.why: Sets output folder for draft images.
leaves a timestamp on the folder. Personal preference
This will put the prefix name in the folder. Good for sorting ...if you change the name.

zh.title: 保存草稿与元数据
zh.text: 把草稿保存到 'Drafts' 文件夹。嵌入工作流和 CivitAI metadata 方便追踪。

4066|folder.text: 设置草稿图的输出文件夹。

4068|timestamp.text: 在文件夹上加时间戳。个人偏好

4068|include_prefix_in_path.text: 会把前缀名放进文件夹名里。方便分类……前提是你改了名字。

ja.title: Save Draft & Metadata
ja.text: 下書きを 'Drafts' フォルダに保存。管理用にワークフローと CivitAI メタデータを埋め込みます。

4066|folder.text: ドラフト画像の出力フォルダを設定します。

4068|timestamp.text: フォルダにタイムスタンプを付けます。好みの問題です。

4068|include_prefix_in_path.text: プレフィックス名をフォルダに入れます。並べ替えに便利……名前を変えれば、ですが。

ko.title: Save Draft & Metadata
ko.text: draft를 'Drafts' 폴더에 저장합니다. 추적을 위해 워크플로우와 CivitAI 메타데이터를 임베드하세요.

4068|include_prefix_in_path.text: 폴더에 prefix 이름이 붙습니다. 정리하기 좋아요 ...이름을 바꾼다면요.
